verses.1: Blessed is the man that hath not walked in the counsel of the ungodly, nor stood in the way of sinners, / and hath not sat in the seat of the scornful.
verses.2: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; / and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
verses.3: And he shall be like a tree planted by the water-side, / that bringeth forth his fruit in due season,
verses.4: Whose leaf also doth not wither; / and look, whatsoever he doeth, it shall prosper.
verses.5: As for the ungodly, it is not so with them; / but they are like the chaff, which the wind scattereth away from the face of the earth.
verses.6: Therefore the ungodly shall not be able to stand in the judgement, / neither the sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
verses.7: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous; / but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

verses.1: Why do the nations so furiously rage together, / and why do the peoples imagine a vain thing?
verses.2: The kings of the earth stand up, and the rulers take counsel together, / against the LORD, and against his anointed:
verses.3: ‘Let us break their bonds asunder, / and cast away their cords from us.’
verses.4: He that dwelleth in heaven shall laugh them to scorn; / the Lord shall have them in derision.
verses.5: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, / and vex them in his sore displeasure:
verses.6: ‘Yet have I set my king / upon my holy hill of Sion.’
verses.7: I Will tell of the decree of the LORD, wherein he hath said unto me, / ‘Thou art my son, this day have I begotten thee.
verses.8: Desire of me, and I shall give thee the nations for thine inheritance, / and the utmost parts of the earth for thy possession.
verses.9: Thou shalt bruise them with a rod of iron, / and break them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.’
verses.10: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings; / be warned, ye that are judges of the earth.
verses.11: Serve the LORD with fear, / and bow down unto him with reverence;
verses.12: Lest he be angry, and ye perish in the way; for his wrath is quickly kindled. / Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.

verses.1: Lord, how are they increased that trouble me! / many are they that rise against me.
verses.2: Many there be that say of my soul, / ‘There is no help for him in his God.’
verses.3: But thou, O LORD, art my defender; / thou art my glory, and the lifter up of my head.
verses.4: I did call upon the LORD with my voice, / and he heard me out of his holy hill.
verses.5: I Laid me down and slept; / I rose up again, for the LORD sustained me.
verses.6: I will not be afraid for ten thousands of the people, / that have set themselves against me round about.
verses.7: Up, LORD, and help me, O my God, / for thou smitest all mine enemies upon the cheek; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.
verses.8: Salvation belongeth unto the LORD; / let thy blessing be upon thy people.

verses.1: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: / thou hast set me at liberty when I was in trouble; have mercy upon me, and hearken unto my prayer.
verses.2: O Ye sons of men, how long will ye blaspheme mine honour, / and have such pleasure in vanity, and seek after falsehood?
verses.3: Know this also, that the LORD hath chosen to himself the man that is godly; / when I call upon the LORD, he will hear me.
verses.4: Stand in awe, and sin not; / commune with your own heart, and in your chamber, and be still.
verses.5: Offer the sacrifice of righteousness, / and put your trust in the LORD.
verses.6: There be many that say, ‘Who will show us any good?’ / LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
verses.7: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, / more than men have when their grain and wine increase.
verses.8: I will lay me down in peace, and take my rest; / for it is thou, LORD, only, that makest me dwell in safety.

verses.1: Ponder my words, O LORD; / consider my meditation.
verses.2: Hearken thou unto the voice of my calling, my King and my God; / for unto thee will I make my prayer.
verses.3: My voice shalt thou hear betimes, O LORD; / early in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
verses.4: For thou art the God that hath no pleasure in wickedness;/neither shall any evil dwell with thee.
verses.5: Such as are boastful shall not stand in thy sight; / for thou hatest all them that work iniquity.
verses.6: Thou shalt destroy them that speak lies; / the LORD abhorreth both the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
verses.7: But as for me, I will come into thy house through the multitude of thy mercies; / and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
verses.8: Lead me, O LORD in thy righteousness, because of mine enemies; / make thy way plain before my face.
verses.9: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; / their inward parts are very wickedness.
verses.10: Their throat is an open sepulchre; / they flatter with their tongue.
verses.11: Give sentence upon them, O God; / let them perish through their own imaginations:
verses.12: Cast them out in the multitude of their ungodliness; / for they have rebelled against thee.
verses.13: But let all them that put their trust in thee rejoice; / let them ever be giving of thanks, because thou defendest them; they that love thy Name shall be joyful in thee;
verses.14: For thou, LORD, wilt give thy blessing unto the righteous, / and with thy favourable kindness wilt thou defend him as with a shield.

verses.1: O Lord, rebuke me not in thine indignation, / neither chasten me in thy displeasure.
verses.2: Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am weak; / O LORD, heal me, for my bones are vexed.
verses.3: My soul also is sore troubled: / but thou, O LORD, how long?
verses.4: Turn thee, O LORD, and deliver my soul; / O save me for thy mercy’s sake.
verses.5: For in death no man remembereth thee; / and who will give thee thanks in the pit?
verses.6: I Am weary of my groaning; / every night wash I my bed, and water my couch with my tears.
verses.7: My beauty is gone for very trouble, / and worn away because of all mine enemies.
verses.8: Away from me, all ye that work iniquity; / for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.9: The LORD hath heard my petition; / the LORD will receive my prayer.
verses.10: All mine enemies shall be confounded, and sore vexed; / they shall be turned back, and put to shame suddenly.

verses.1: O Lord my God, in thee have I put my trust: / save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me;
verses.2: Lest mine enemy devour my soul like a lion, / and tear it in pieces, while there is none to help.
verses.3: O Lord my God, if I have done any such thing; / or if there be any wickedness in my hands;
verses.4: If I have rewarded evil unto him that dealt friendly with me; / (yea rather, I have delivered him that without any cause is mine enemy;)
verses.5: Then let mine enemy persecute my soul, and take me; / yea, let him tread my life down upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust.
verses.6: Stand up, O LORD, in thy wrath, and lift up thyself against the fury of mine enemies; / arise up for me in the judgement that thou hast commanded.
verses.7: And let the congregation of the peoples come about thee; / and over it take thy seat on high.
verses.8: The LORD shall judge the peoples: give sentence for me, O LORD, / according to my righteousness, and according to the innocency that is in me.
verses.9: O let the wickedness of the ungodly come to an end; / but guide thou the just.
verses.10: For the righteous God / trieth the very minds and hearts.
verses.11: My help cometh of God, / who preserveth them that are true of heart.
verses.12: God is a righteous judge, strong and patient; / and God is provoked every day.
verses.13: If a man will not turn, he will whet his sword; / he hath bent his bow and made it ready.
verses.14: He hath prepared for him the instruments of death; / he maketh his arrows fiery darts.
verses.15: Behold, the ungodly travaileth with iniquity; / he hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
verses.16: He hath graven and digged up a pit, / and is fallen himself into the snare that he hath made.
verses.17: For his mischief shall come upon his own head, / and his wickedness shall fall on his own pate.
verses.18: I will give thanks unto the LORD according to his righteousness; / and I will praise the Name of the LORD Most High.

verses.1: O Lord our Governor, how excellent is thy Name in all the world, / thou that hast set thy glory above the heavens!
verses.2: Out of the mouth of very babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength, because of thine enemies, / that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
verses.3: When I consider thy heavens, even the work of thy fingers; / the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
verses.4: What is man, that thou art mindful of him, / and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verses.5: Thou hast made him but little lower than the angels, / and dost crown him with glory and worship.
verses.6: Thou makest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; / and thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet;
verses.7: All sheep and oxen; / yea, and the beasts of the field;
verses.8: The birds of the air, and the fishes of the sea; / and whatsoever moveth through the paths of the seas.
verses.9: O Lord our Governor, / how excellent is thy Name in all the world!

verses.1: I Will give thanks unto thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; / I will speak of all thy marvellous works.
verses.2: I will be glad and rejoice in thee; / yea, my songs will I make of thy Name, O thou Most High.
verses.3: While mine enemies are driven back, / they shall fall and perish at thy presence.
verses.4: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; / thou art set on the throne, thou that judgest right.
verses.5: Thou hast rebuked the nations, / and destroyed the ungodly; / thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
verses.6: The enemy are come to a perpetual end, and left desolate for ever: / even as the cities which thou hast destroyed, the remembrance of them is perished.
verses.7: But the LORD shall endure for ever; / he hath also prepared his throne for judgement.
verses.8: For he will judge the world in righteousness, / and minister true judgement unto the peoples.
verses.9: The LORD also will be a defence for the oppressed, / even a refuge in the time of trouble.
verses.10: And they that know thy Name will put their trust in thee; / for thou, LORD, hast never failed them that seek thee.
verses.11: O Praise the LORD who dwelleth in Sion; / show the people of his doings.
verses.12: For he that avengeth blood remembereth them, / and forgetteth not the complaint of the poor.
verses.13: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider the trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, / thou that liftest me up from the gates of death;
verses.14: That I may show all thy praises within the gates of the daughter of Sion: / I will rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.15: The nations are sunk down in the pit that they made; / in the same net that they hid is their foot taken.
verses.16: The LORD hath made himself known; he hath executed judgement; / the ungodly is trapped in the work of his own hands.
verses.17: The wicked shall be turned into hell, / and all the nations that forget God.
verses.18: For the poor shall not alway be forgotten; / the patient abiding of the meek shall not perish for ever.
verses.19: Up, LORD, and let not man have the upper hand; / let the nations be judged in thy sight.
verses.20: Put them in fear, O LORD, / that the nations may know themselves to be but men.

verses.1: Why standest thou so far off, O LORD, / and hidest thy face in the needful time of trouble?
verses.2: The ungodly in his pride doth persecute the poor: / let them be taken in the crafty wiliness that they have imagined.
verses.3: For the ungodly maketh boast of his own heart’s desire, / and the covetous man renounceth, yea scorneth the LORD.
verses.4: The ungodly in his pride thinketh that God will not punish, / neither is God in all his thoughts.
verses.5: His ways are always prosperous; / thy judgements are far above out of his sight, and therefore defieth he all his enemies.
verses.6: For he hath said in his heart, ‘Tush, I shall not be cast down; / no harm shall ever happen unto me.’
verses.7: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and fraud; / under his tongue is ungodliness and iniquity.
verses.8: He sitteth lurking in the thievish corners of the streets, / and privily in his lurking dens doth he murder the innocent; his eyes are set against the poor.
verses.9: He lieth waiting secretly, as it were a lion in his den; / he lurketh that he may ravish the poor.
verses.10: He doth ravish the poor, / when he getteth him into his net.
verses.11: He stoopeth down and croucheth, / that the poor may fall into the hands of his captains.
verses.12: He hath said in his heart, ‘Tush, God hath forgotten; / he hideth away his face, and he will never see it.’
verses.13: Arise, O LORD God, and lift up thine hand;/ forget not the poor.
verses.14: Wherefore should the wicked blaspheme God, / while he doth say in his heart, ‘Tush, thou God wilt not seek it out?
verses.15: Surely thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest trouble and sorrow, / that thou mayest take the matter into thy hand.
verses.16: The poor committeth himself unto thee; / for thou art the helper of the friendless.
verses.17: Break thou the power of the ungodly and malicious; / seek out his wickedness until thou find none.
verses.18: The LORD is King for ever and ever, / and the nations are perished out of his land.
verses.19: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the poor; / thou dost establish their heart, and thine ear hearkeneth thereto;
verses.20: To help the fatherless and the oppressed unto their right, / that the men of the earth be no more exalted against them.

verses.1: In the LORD put I my trust; / how say ye then unto my soul, that she should flee as a bird unto the hill?
verses.2: For lo, the ungodly bend their bow, and make ready their arrows upon the string, / that they may privily shoot at them that are true of heart.
verses.3: If the foundations are destroyed, / what can the righteous do?
verses.4: The LORD is in his holy temple; the LORD’S throne is in heaven: / his eyes behold, his eyelids try the children of men.
verses.5: The LORD approveth the righteous: / but the ungodly, and him that delighteth in wickedness, doth his soul abhor.
verses.6: Upon the ungodly he shall rain brimstone and coals of fire; / storm and tempest shall be their portion to drink.
verses.7: For the LORD is righteous; he loveth righteous deeds; / the upright shall behold his face.

verses.1: Help me, LORD, for there is not one godly man left; / for the faithful are vanished from among the children of men.
verses.2: They talk of vanity every one with his neighbour; / they do but flatter with their lips, and dissemble in their double heart.
verses.3: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, / and the tongue that speaketh proud things;
verses.4: Who have said, ‘With our tongue will we prevail; / we are they that ought to speak; who is lord over us?’
verses.5: ‘Now for the comfortless troubles’ sake of the needy, / and because of the deep sighing of the poor,
verses.6: I will up,’ saith the LORD, / ‘and will set him in the safety for which he longeth.’
verses.7: The words of the LORD are pure words; / even as the silver, which from the earth is tried, and purified seven times in the fire.
verses.8: Thou shalt keep us, O LORD;/ thou shalt preserve us from this generation for ever.
verses.9: The ungodly walk on every side, / when wickedness is exalted among the children of men.

verses.1: H ow long wilt thou forget me, O LORD, for ever? / how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
verses.2: How long shall I seek counsel in my soul, and be so vexed in my heart? / how long shall mine enemy triumph over me?
verses.3: Consider and hear me, O LORD my God; / lighten mine eyes, that I sleep not in death;
verses.4: Lest mine enemy say, ‘I have prevailed against him’; / for if I be cast down, they that trouble me will rejoice.
verses.5: But my trust is in thy mercy, / and my heart is joyful in thy salvation.
verses.6: I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt so lovingly with me; / yea, I will praise the Name of the LORD Most High.

verses.1: The fool hath said in his heart, / ‘There is no God.’
verses.2: They are corrupt, and become abominable in their doings; / there is none that doeth good, no not one.
verses.3: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, / to see if there were any that would understand, and seek after God.
verses.4: But they are all gone out of the way, they are altogether become abominable; / there is none that doeth good, no not one.
verses.5: Have they no knowledge, that they are all such workers of mischief, / eating up my people as it were bread, and call not upon the LORD?
verses.6: There were they brought in great fear, even where no fear was; / for God is in the generation of the righteous.
verses.7: As for you, ye have made a mock at the counsel of the poor; / because he putteth his trust in the LORD.
verses.8: O That salvation for Israel were come out of Sion! / When the LORD restoreth the fortunes of his people,
verses.9: Then shall Jacob rejoice, / and Israel shall be right glad.

verses.1: Lord, who shall dwell in thy tabernacle? / or who shall rest upon thy holy hill?
verses.2: Even he that leadeth an uncorrupt life, and doeth the thing which is right, / and speaketh the truth from his heart.
verses.3: He that hath used no deceit in his tongue, nor done evil to his neighbour, / and hath not slandered his neighbour.
verses.4: He in whose eyes an ungodly man is despised, / but he maketh much of them that fear the LORD.
verses.5: He that sweareth unto his neighbour, and disappointeth him not, / though it were to his own hindrance.
verses.6: He that hath not given his money upon usury, / nor taken a bribe against the innocent.
verses.7: Whoso doeth these things / shall never fall.

verses.1: Preserve me, O God, / for in thee have I put my trust.
verses.2: I have said unto the LORD, ‘Thou art my God: / I have no good apart from thee.’
verses.3: All my delight is upon the saints that are in the earth, / and upon such as excel in virtue.
verses.4: But they that run after another god / shall have great trouble.
verses.5: Their drink-offerings of blood will I not offer, / neither make mention of their names within my lips.
verses.6: The LORD himself is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: / thou shalt maintain my lot.
verses.7: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places: / yea, I have a goodly heritage.
verses.8: I Will thank the LORD for giving me counsel; / my heart also instructeth me in the night-season.
verses.9: I have set the LORD always before me; / for he is on my right hand, therefore I shall not fall.
verses.10: Wherefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth; / my flesh also shall dwell in safety.
verses.11: For why? thou wilt not leave my soul to hell; / neither wilt thou suffer thy holy one to see corruption.
verses.12: Thou shalt show me the path of life; in thy presence is the fulness of joy, / and at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

verses.1: Hear the right, O LORD, Consider my complaint, / and hearken unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
verses.2: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; / and let thine eyes look upon the thing that is right.
verses.3: Thou hast proved and visited mine heart in the night-season; thou hast tried me, and shalt find no wickedness in me; / for I am utterly purposed that my mouth shall not offend.
verses.4: As for the works of men, by the word of thy lips / I have kept me from the ways of the destroyer.
verses.5: My steps have held fast to thy paths, / and my feet have not slipped.
verses.6: I Have called upon thee, O God, for thou shalt hear me: / incline thine ear to me, and hearken unto my words.
verses.7: Show thy marvellous loving-kindness, thou that art the Saviour of them that put their trust in thee, / from such as resist thy right hand.
verses.8: Keep me as the apple of an eye; / hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
verses.9: From the ungodly that trouble me, / even mine enemies that compass me round about to take away my soul.
verses.10: They close their heart to pity, / and their mouth speaketh proud things.
verses.11: They lie waiting in our way on every side, / watching to cast us down to the ground;
verses.12: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, / and as it were a lion’s whelp lurking in secret places.
verses.13: Up, LORD, confront him, and cast him down;/ deliver my soul from the ungodly by thy sword;
verses.14: By thy hand from men, O LORD, from men of the world; / who have their portion in this life, and whose bellies thou fillest with thy treasure.
verses.15: They have children at their desire, / and leave the rest of their substance for their babes.
verses.16: But as for me, I shall behold thy presence in righteousness; / and when I awake, I shall be satisfied with thy likeness.

verses.1: I Love thee, O LORD, my strength. / The LORD is my stony rock, my defence, and my Saviour;
verses.2: My God, and my might, in whom I will trust; / my shield, the horn also of my salvation, and my refuge.
verses.3: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; / so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
verses.4: The waves of death compassed me, / and the floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
verses.5: The cords of hell came about me; / the snares of death overtook me.
verses.6: In my trouble I called upon the LORD, / and complained unto my God.
verses.7: So he heard my voice out of his holy temple, / and my complaint before him entered into his ears.
verses.8: The earth trembled and quaked; / the very foundations also of the hills shook, and were moved, because he was wroth.
verses.9: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and a consuming fire out of his mouth, / so that coals were kindled at it.
verses.10: He bowed the heavens also, and came down, / and it was dark under his feet.
verses.11: He rode upon the cherubim, and did fly; / he came flying upon the wings of the wind.
verses.12: He made darkness his secret place, and his pavilion round about him, / with dark water and thick clouds to cover him.
verses.13: At the brightness of his presence his clouds removed; / hail-stones and coals of fire.
verses.14: The LORD also thundered out of heaven, and the Highest uttered his voice; / hail-stones and coals of fire.
verses.15: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them; he cast forth his lightnings, and destroyed them.
verses.16: The springs of waters were seen, / and the foundations of the round world were uncovered,
verses.17: At thy chiding, O LORD, / at the blasting of the breath of thy displeasure.
verses.18: He sent from on high, and took me, / and he drew me out of many waters.
verses.19: He delivered me from my strongest enemy, / and from them that hate me, for they were too mighty for me.
verses.20: They came upon me in the day of my trouble; / but the LORD was my upholder.
verses.21: He brought me forth also into a place of liberty; / he delivered me, even because he had a favour unto me.
verses.22: The LORD rewarded me after my righteous dealing; / according to the cleanness of my hands did he recompense me.
verses.23: Because I have kept the ways of the LORD, / and have not forsaken my God, as the wicked doth.
verses.24: For I had an eye unto all his laws, / and did not cast out his commandments from me.
verses.25: I was also uncorrupt before him, / and kept myself from mine own wickedness.
verses.26: Therefore the LORD rewarded me after my righteous dealing, / and according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
verses.27: With the merciful thou shalt show thyself merciful; / and with a perfect man thou shalt be perfect.
verses.28: With the pure thou shalt show thyself pure; / and with the perverse thou shalt deal accordingly.
verses.29: For thou shalt save the people that are lowly, / and shalt bring down the high looks of the proud.
verses.30: Thou also shalt light my candle; / the LORD my God shall make my darkness to be light.
verses.31: For in thee I can discomfit an host of men, / and with the help of my God I can leap over the wall.
verses.32: The way of God is an undefiled way: / the word of the LORD also is tried in the fire; he is the defender of all them that put their trust in him.
verses.33: For who is God but the LORD? / or who hath any strength except our God?
verses.34: It is God that girdeth me with strength, / and maketh my way perfect.
verses.35: He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet, / and setteth me up on high.
verses.36: He teacheth my hands to fight, / so that mine arms can bend even a bow of steel.
verses.37: Thou hast given me the defence of thy salvation; / thy right hand also hath held me up, and thy loving correction hath made me great.
verses.38: Thou hast made room enough under me for to go, / that my footsteps did not slide.
verses.39: I followed upon mine enemies and overtook them; / neither did I turn again till I had destroyed them.
verses.40: I smote them, that they were not able to stand, / but fell under my feet.
verses.41: Thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle; / thou hast thrown down mine enemies under me.
verses.42: Thou didst make mine enemies also to turn their backs upon me, / and I destroyed them that hated me.
verses.43: They cried, but there was none to help them; / yea, even unto the LORD did they cry, but he did not hear them.
verses.44: I beat them as small as the dust before the wind: / I cast them out as the clay in the streets.
verses.45: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people, and hast made me the head of the nations; / a people whom I had not known did serve me.
verses.46: As soon as they heard of me, they obeyed me; / and strangers humbled themselves before me.
verses.47: The strangers lost heart, / and came trembling out of their strongholds.
verses.48: The LORD liveth, and blessed be my strong helper, / and praised be the God of my salvation;
verses.49: Even the God that seeth that I be avenged, / and subdueth the peoples under me.
verses.50: It is thou that deliverest me from my cruel enemies, and settest me up above mine adversaries: / thou dost rid me from the wicked man.
verses.51: For this cause will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the nations, / and sing praises unto thy Name.
verses.52: Great deliverance giveth he unto his king, / and showeth loving-kindness unto his anointed, unto David and unto his seed for evermore.

verses.1: The heavens declare the glory of God; / and the firmament showeth his handy-work.
verses.2: One day telleth another; / and one night certifieth another.
verses.3: There is neither speech nor language; / their voice cannot be heard;
verses.4: Yet their sound is gone out into all lands; / and their words into the ends of the world.
verses.5: In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun; / which cometh forth as a bridegroom out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a giant to run his course.
verses.6: It goeth forth from the uttermost part of the heaven, and runneth about unto the end of it again; / and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
verses.7: The law of the LORD is an undefiled law, restoring the soul; / the testimony of the LORD is sure, and giveth wisdom unto the simple.
verses.8: The precepts of the LORD are right, and rejoice the heart; / the commandment of the LORD is pure, and giveth light unto the eyes.
verses.9: The fear of the LORD is clean, and endureth for ever; / the judgements of the LORD are true, and righteous altogether.
verses.10: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold; / sweeter also than honey, and the honey-comb.
verses.11: Moreover, by them is thy servant taught; / and in keeping of them there is great reward.
verses.12: Who can tell how oft he offendeth? / O cleanse thou me from my secret faults.
verses.13: Keep thy servant also from presumptuous sins, lest they get the dominion over me; / so shall I be undefiled and innocent from the great offence.
verses.14: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be alway acceptable in thy sight, / O LORD, my strength and my redeemer.

verses.1: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; / the Name of the God of Jacob defend thee;
verses.2: Send thee help from the sanctuary, / and strengthen thee out of Sion;
verses.3: Remember all thy offerings, / and accept thy burnt sacrifice;
verses.4: Grant thee thy heart’s desire, / and fulfil all thy mind.
verses.5: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and triumph in the Name of our God: / the LORD perform all thy petitions.
verses.6: Now know I that the LORD helpeth his anointed, and will hear him from his holy heaven, / even with the wholesome strength of his right hand.
verses.7: Some put their trust in chariots, and some in horses; / but we will remember the Name of the LORD our God.
verses.8: They are brought down, and fallen; / but we are risen and stand upright.
verses.9: O Lord, save the king, / and mercifully hear us when we call upon thee.

verses.1: The king shall rejoice in thy strength, O LORD; / exceeding glad shall he be of thy salvation.
verses.2: Thou hast given him his heart’s desire, / and hast not denied him the request of his lips.
verses.3: For thou dost meet him with the blessings of goodness, / and settest a crown of pure gold upon his head.
verses.4: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it to him, / even length of days for evermore.
verses.5: His honour is great in thy salvation; / glory and great worship dost thou lay upon him.
verses.6: For thou dost give him everlasting felicity, / and makest him glad with the joy of thy countenance.
verses.7: And why? because the king putteth his trust in the LORD;/ and in the mercy of the Most High he shall not miscarry.
verses.8: All thine enemies shall feel thy hand; / thy right hand shall find out them that hate thee.
verses.9: Thou shalt make them like a fiery oven in time of thy wrath: / the LORD shall destroy them in his displeasure, and the fire shall consume them.
verses.10: Their offspring shalt thou root out of the earth, / and their seed from among the children of men.
verses.11: For they intended mischief against thee, / and imagined such a device as they were not able to perform.
verses.12: Therefore shalt thou put them to flight, / and the strings of thy bow shalt thou make ready against the face of them.
verses.13: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength; / so will we sing, and praise thy power.

verses.1: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me, / and art so far from my help, and from the words of my complaint?
verses.2: O my God, I cry in the day-time, but thou hearest not; / and in the night-season also I take no rest.
verses.3: And thou continuest holy, / O thou worship of Israel.
verses.4: Our fathers trusted in thee; / they trusted in thee, and thou didst deliver them.
verses.5: They called upon thee, and were saved; / they put their trust in thee, and were not confounded.
verses.6: But as for me, I am a worm and no man; / a very scorn of men, and the outcast of the people.
verses.7: All they that see me laugh me to scorn; / they shoot out their lips, and shake their heads,
verses.8: Saying, ‘He trusted in God, that he would deliver him; / let him deliver him, if he delighteth in him.’
verses.9: But thou art he that took me from the womb; / thou wast my hope, when I hanged yet upon my mother’s breasts.
verses.10: I have been left unto thee ever since I was born; / thou art my God even from my mother’s womb.
verses.11: O go not from me, for trouble is hard at hand, / and there is none to help me.
verses.12: Many oxen are come about me; / strong bulls of Bashan close me in on every side.
verses.13: They gape upon me with their mouths, / as it were a ramping and a roaring lion.
verses.14: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint; / my heart also in the midst of my body is even like melting wax.
verses.15: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue cleaveth to my gums, / and thou bringest me into the dust of death.
verses.16: For many dogs are come about me, / and the council of the wicked layeth siege against me.
verses.17: They pierced my hands and my feet; I may count all my bones: / they stand staring and looking upon me.
verses.18: They part my garments among them, / and cast lots upon my vesture.
verses.19: But be not thou far from me, O LORD;/ thou art my succour, haste thee to help me.
verses.20: Deliver my soul from the sword, / and my life from the power of the dog.
verses.21: Save me from the lion’s mouth; / thou hast heard me also from among the horns of the wild oxen.
verses.22: I Will declare thy Name unto my brethren; / in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.
verses.23: O praise the LORD, ye that fear him: / magnify him, all ye of the seed of Jacob, and stand in awe of him, all ye seed of Israel.
verses.24: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the low estate of the poor; / he hath not hid his face from him; but when he called unto him he heard him.
verses.25: Of thee cometh my praise in the great congregation; / my vows will I perform in the sight of them that fear him.
verses.26: The poor shall eat and be satisfied; they that seek after the LORD shall praise him; / may your heart live for ever.
verses.27: All the ends of the world shall remember, and be turned unto the LORD;/ and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before him.
verses.28: For the kingdom is the LORD’ S, / and he is the Governor among the nations.
verses.29: Surely to him shall all the proud of the earth bow down; / and before him shall kneel all that go down into the dust, and he that cannot keep his soul alive.
verses.30: Their posterity shall serve him; / it shall be told of the Lord unto a generation yet to come.
verses.31: And men shall declare his righteousness / unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done it.

verses.1: The LORD is my shepherd; / therefore can I lack nothing.
verses.2: He shall feed me in a green pasture, / and lead me forth beside the waters of comfort.
verses.3: He shall restore my soul, / and bring me forth in the paths of righteousness, for his Name’s sake.
verses.4: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; / for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff comfort me.
verses.5: Thou shalt prepare a table before me in the presence of them that trouble me; / thou hast anointed my head with oil, and my cup shall be full.
verses.6: Surely thy loving-kindness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life; / and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.

verses.1: The earth is the LORD’ S, and all that therein is; / the compass of the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.2: For he hath founded it upon the seas, / and established it upon the floods.
verses.3: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? / or who shall stand in his holy place?
verses.4: Even he that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; / and that hath not lift up his mind unto vanity, nor sworn to deceive his neighbour.
verses.5: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, / and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.6: This is the generation of them that seek him; / even of them that seek thy face, O God of Jacob.
verses.7: Lift up your heads, O ye gates, and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; / and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.8: Who is the King of glory? / it is the LORD strong and mighty, even the LORD mighty in battle.
verses.9: Lift up your heads, O ye gates, and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; / and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.10: Who is the King of glory? / even the LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory.

verses.1: Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul; / my God, I have put my trust in thee.
verses.2: O let me not be confounded, / neither let mine enemies triumph over me.
verses.3: For all they that hope in thee shall not be ashamed; / but such as transgress without a cause shall be put to confusion.
verses.4: Show me thy ways, O LORD, / and teach me thy paths.
verses.5: Lead me forth in thy truth and teach me: / for thou art the God of my salvation; in thee is my hope all the day long.
verses.6: Call to remembrance, O LORD, thy tender mercies, / and thy loving-kindnesses, which have been ever of old.
verses.7: O remember not the sins and offences of my youth; / but according to thy mercy think thou upon me, O LORD, for thy goodness.
verses.8: Gracious and righteous is the LORD; / therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
verses.9: Them that are meek shall he guide in judgement; / and such as are gentle, them shall he teach his way.
verses.10: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth, / unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.11: For thy Name’s sake, O LORD,/ be merciful unto my sin, for it is great.
verses.12: What man is he that feareth the LORD? / him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.
verses.13: His soul shall dwell at ease, / and his seed shall inherit the land.
verses.14: The secret of the LORD is for them that fear him; / and he will show them his covenant.
verses.15: Mine eyes are ever looking unto the LORD; / for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.16: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; / for I am desolate and in misery.
verses.17: Relieve thou the sorrows of my heart: / O bring thou me out of my troubles.
verses.18: Look upon my adversity and misery, / and forgive me all my sins.
verses.19: Consider mine enemies, how many they are; / and they bear a tyrannous hate against me.
verses.20: O keep my soul, and deliver me; / let me not be confounded, for I have put my trust in thee.
verses.21: Let perfectness and righteous dealing preserve me; / for my hope is in thee.
verses.22: Deliver Israel, O God, / out of all his troubles.

verses.1: Be thou my judge, O LORD, for I have walked innocently: / my trust hath been also in the LORD, therefore shall I not fall.
verses.2: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me: / try me in heart and mind.
verses.3: For thy loving-kindness is ever before mine eyes; / and I have walked in thy truth.
verses.4: I Have not sat with vain persons; / neither will I have fellowship with the deceitful.
verses.5: I hate the congregation of the wicked, / and I will not sit among the ungodly.
verses.6: I Will wash my hands in innocency, O LORD, / and so will I go to thine altar;
verses.7: That I may show the voice of thanksgiving, / and tell of all thy wondrous works.
verses.8: LORD, I love the habitation of thy house, / and the place where thine honour dwelleth.
verses.9: O Take not away my soul with the sinners, / nor my life with the bloodthirsty;
verses.10: In whose hands is wickedness, / and their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.11: But as for me, I will walk innocently; / O deliver me, and be merciful unto me.
verses.12: My foot standeth right: / I will praise the LORD in the congregations.

verses.1: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom then shall I fear? / the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom then shall I be afraid?
verses.2: When the wicked came upon me to eat up my flesh, / even mine enemies and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
verses.3: Though an host of men were laid against me, yet shall not my heart be afraid; / and though there rose up war against me, yet will I put my trust in him.
verses.4: One thing have I desired of the LORD, which I will require: / even that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the fair beauty of the LORD, and to visit his temple.
verses.5: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his tabernacle; / yea, in the secret place of his dwelling shall he hide me, and set me up upon a rock of stone.
verses.6: And now shall my head be lifted up / above mine enemies round about me.
verses.7: Therefore will I offer in his dwelling an oblation with great gladness: / I will sing, and speak praises unto the LORD.
verses.8: Hearken unto my voice, O LORD, when I cry unto thee; / have mercy upon me and hear me.
verses.9: My heart hath talked with thee: ‘Seek ye my face’; / ‘Thy face, LORD, will I seek.’
verses.10: O hide not thy face from me, / nor cast thy servant away in displeasure.
verses.11: Thou hast been my succour; / leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.
verses.12: When my father and my mother forsake me, / the LORD taketh me up.
verses.13: Teach me thy way, O LORD, / and lead me in the right way, because of mine enemies.
verses.14: Deliver me not over into the will of mine adversaries; / for there are false witnesses risen up against me, and such as speak wrong.
verses.15: I believe that I shall see the goodness of the LORD / in the land of the living.
verses.16: O tarry thou the LORD’ S leisure; / be strong, and let thy heart take courage, and wait upon the LORD.

verses.1: Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my strength; be not deaf to my prayer; / lest, if thou make as though thou hearest not, I become like them that go down into the pit.
verses.2: Hear the voice of my humble petitions, when I cry unto thee; / when I hold up my hands towards thy holy temple.
verses.3: O pluck me not away with the ungodly and wicked doers, / who speak friendly to their neighbours, but imagine mischief in their hearts.
verses.4: Reward them according to their deeds, / and according to the wickedness of their own inventions.
verses.5: Recompense them after the work of their hands; / pay them that they have deserved.
verses.6: Because they regard not in their mind the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, / therefore shall he break them down, and not build them up.
verses.7: Praised be the LORD;/ for he hath heard the voice of my humble petitions.
verses.8: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart hath trusted in him, and I am helped; / therefore my heart danceth for joy, and in my song will I praise him.
verses.9: The LORD is the strength of his people; / and he is the wholesome defence of his anointed.
verses.10: O Lord, save thy people, and bless thine heritage: / govern them, and lift them up for ever.

verses.1: Ascribe unto the LORD, O ye mighty, / ascribe unto the LORD worship and strength.
verses.2: Give unto the LORD the honour due unto his Name; / worship the LORD with holy worship.
verses.3: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters; / it is the glorious God that maketh the thunder, even the LORD upon many waters.
verses.4: The voice of the LORD is mighty in operation; / the voice of the LORD is a glorious voice.
verses.5: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedartrees; / yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.6: He maketh Lebanon to skip like a calf, / and Sirion like a young ox.
verses.7: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire; the voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; / yea, the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.8: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to bring forth young, and strippeth bare the forests: / in his temple doth every thing speak of his honour.
verses.9: The LORD sitteth above the water-flood, / and the LORD remaineth a King for ever.
verses.10: The LORD shall give strength unto his people; / the LORD shall give his people the blessing of peace.

verses.1: I Will magnify thee, O LORD, for thou hast set me up, / and not made my foes to triumph over me.
verses.2: O Lord my God, I cried unto thee, / and thou hast healed me.
verses.3: Thou, LORD, hast brought up my soul from hell: / thou hast kept my life from them that go down to the pit.
verses.4: Sing praises unto the LORD, O ye saints of his; / and give thanks unto his holy Name.
verses.5: For his wrath endureth but the twinkling of an eye, and in his favour is life; / heaviness may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
verses.6: As for me, in my prosperity I said, ‘I shall never be moved’; / thou, LORD, of thy goodness hadst made my hill so strong.
verses.7: But thou didst turn thy face from me, / and I was troubled.
verses.8: Then cried I unto thee, O LORD, / and gat me to my Lord right humbly:
verses.9: ‘What profit is there in my blood, / when I go down to the pit?
verses.10: Shall the dust give thanks unto thee? / or shall it declare thy truth?
verses.11: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me; / LORD, be thou my helper.’
verses.12: Thou hast turned my heaviness into joy; / thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
verses.13: That my soul may sing of thy praise without ceasing. / O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.

verses.1: In thee, O LORD, have I put my trust; / let me never be put to confusion; deliver me in thy righteousness.
verses.2: Bow down thine ear to me; / make haste to deliver me,
verses.3: And be thou my strong rock and house of defence, / that thou mayest save me.
verses.4: For thou art my strong rock and my castle: / be thou also my guide, and lead me for thy Name’s sake.
verses.5: Draw me out of the net that they have hidden for me; / for thou art my strength.
verses.6: Into thy hands I commend my spirit; / for thou hast redeemed me, O LORD, thou God of truth.
verses.7: I hate them that hold of superstitious vanities; / but as for me, my trust is in the LORD.
verses.8: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy; / for thou hast considered my trouble, and hast known my soul in adversities.
verses.9: Thou hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy; / but hast set my feet in a broad place.
verses.10: Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble, / and mine eye is consumed for very heaviness; yea, my soul and my body.
verses.11: For my life is waxen old with sorrow, / and my years with mourning.
verses.12: My strength faileth me because of my adversity, / and my bones are consumed.
verses.13: I am become a reproach because of all mine enemies, / and especially unto my neighbours;
verses.14: And they of mine acquaintance are afraid of me; / and they that see me in the street flee from me.
verses.15: I am clean forgotten, as a dead man out of mind; / I am become like a broken vessel.
verses.16: For I have heard the whispering of the multitude, and fear is on every side; / while they conspire together against me, and plot to take away my life.
verses.17: But my hope hath been in thee, O LORD; / I have said, ‘Thou art my God.’
verses.18: My times are in thy hand; / deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
verses.19: Show thy servant the light of thy countenance, / and save me for thy mercy’s sake.
verses.20: Let me not be confounded, O LORD, for I have called upon thee; / let the ungodly be put to confusion, and be put to silence in the grave.
verses.21: Let the lying lips be put to silence, / which cruelly, disdainfully, and despitefully, speak against the righteous.
verses.22: O How plentifal is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee, / and that thou hast wrought for them that put their trust in thee, even before the sons of men!
verses.23: Thou hidest them in the secret place of thine own presence from the plottings of men: / thou keepest them secretly in thy tabernacle from the strife of tongues.
verses.24: Thanks be to the LORD;/ for he hath showed me his marvellous loving-kindness in a strong city.
verses.25: But as for me, I said in my haste, / ‘I am cast out of the sight of thine eyes.’
verses.26: Nevertheless, thou heardest the voice of my prayer, / when I cried unto thee.
verses.27: O Love the LORD, all ye his saints; / for the LORD preserveth them that are faithful, and plenteously rewardeth the proud doer.
verses.28: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, / all ye that put your trust in the LORD.

verses.1: Blessed is he whose unrighteousness is forgiven, / and whose sin is covered.
verses.2: Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth no sin, / and in whose spirit there is no guile.
verses.3: For while I held my tongue, / my bones consumed away through my daily complaining.
verses.4: For thy hand was heavy upon me day and night, / and my moisture was changed as with the drought of summer.
verses.5: I acknowledged my sin unto thee; / and mine unrighteousness have I not hid.
verses.6: I said, ‘I will confess my sins unto the LORD’; / and so thou forgavest the wickedness of my sin.
verses.7: For this shall every one that is godly make his prayer unto thee, in a time when thou mayest be found; / when the great waters overflow, they shall not come nigh him.
verses.8: Thou art a place to hide me in; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; / thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance.
verses.9: I Will inform thee, and teach thee in the way wherein thou shalt go; / and I will guide thee with mine eye upon thee.
verses.10: Be ye not like to horse and mule, which have no understanding; / whose mouths must be held with bit and bridle, else they will not come nigh thee.
verses.11: Great plagues remain for the ungodly; / but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD, mercy embraceth him on every side.
verses.12: Be glad, O ye righteous, and rejoice in the LORD; / and be joyful, all ye that are true of heart.

verses.1: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous; / for it becometh well the just to be thankful.
verses.2: Praise the LORD with harp: / sing praises unto him with the lute, and instrument of ten strings.
verses.3: Sing unto the LORD a new song: / sing praises lustily with a good courage.
verses.4: For the word of the LORD is true, / and all his works are faithful.
verses.5: He loveth righteousness and judgement: / the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.
verses.6: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made, / and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
verses.7: He gathereth the waters of the sea together, as it were in a bottle, / and layeth up the deep, as in a treasure-house.
verses.8: Let all the earth fear the LORD; / stand in awe of him, all ye that dwell in the world.
verses.9: For he spake, and it was done: / he commanded, and it stood fast.
verses.10: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the nations to nought, / and maketh the devices of the peoples to be of none effect.
verses.11: The counsel of the LORD shall endure for ever, / and the thoughts of his heart from generation to generation.
verses.12: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, / and blessed are the folk that he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
verses.13: The LORD looketh down from heaven, / and beholdeth all the children of men;
verses.14: From the habitation of his dwelling / he considereth all them that dwell on the earth.
verses.15: He fashioneth all the hearts of them, / and understandeth all their works.
verses.16: There is no king that can be saved by the multitude of an host, / neither is any mighty man delivered by much strength.
verses.17: A horse is counted but a vain thing to save a man, / neither shall he deliver any man by his great strength.
verses.18: Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon them that fear him, / and upon them that put their trust in his mercy;
verses.19: To deliver their soul from death, / and to feed them in the time of dearth.
verses.20: Our soul hath patiently tarried for the LORD; / for he is our help and our shield.
verses.21: For our heart shall rejoice in him; / because we have hoped in his holy Name.
verses.22: O Lord, let thy mercy lighten upon us, / like as we do put our trust in thee.

verses.1: I Will alway give thanks unto the LORD; / his praise shall ever be in my mouth.
verses.2: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD; / the humble shall hear thereof and be glad.
verses.3: O praise the LORD with me, / and let us magnify his Name together.
verses.4: I sought the LORD, and he heard me; / yea, he delivered me out of all my fears.
verses.5: O look unto him and be lightened; / and your faces shall not be ashamed.
verses.6: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him; / yea, and saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.7: The angel of the LORD tarrieth round about them that fear him, / and delivereth them.
verses.8: O taste and see how gracious the LORD is: / blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
verses.9: O fear the LORD, ye that are his saints; / for they that fear him lack nothing.
verses.10: The lions do lack, and suffer hunger; / but they who seek the LORD shall want no manner of thing that is good.
verses.11: Come, ye children, and hearken unto me; / I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
verses.12: What man is he that desireth to live, / and would fain see good days?
verses.13: Keep thy tongue from evil, / and thy lips, that they speak no guile.
verses.14: Depart from evil, and do good; / seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.15: The eyes of the LORD are over the righteous, / and his ears are open unto their prayers.
verses.16: The countenance of the LORD is against them that do evil, / to root out the remembrance of them from the earth.
verses.17: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth them, / and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
verses.18: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a contrite heart, / and will save such as be of an humble spirit.
verses.19: Great are the troubles of the righteous; / but the LORD delivereth him out of all.
verses.20: He keepeth all his bones, / so that not one of them is broken.
verses.21: But misfortune shall slay the ungodly; / and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
verses.22: The LORD delivereth the souls of his servants; / and all they that put their trust in him shall not be destitute.

verses.1: Plead thou my cause, O LORD, with them that strive with me, / and fight thou against them that fight against me.
verses.2: Lay hand upon the shield and buckler, / and stand up to help me.
verses.3: Bring forth the spear and stop the way against them that pursue me: / say unto my soul, ‘I am thy Salvation.’
verses.4: Let them be confounded and put to shame, that seek after my soul; / let them be turned back and brought to confusion, that imagine mischief for me.
verses.5: Let them be as the chaff before the wind, / with the angel of the LORD scattering them.
verses.6: Let their way be dark and slippery, / with the angel of the LORD pursuing them.
verses.7: For they have hidden their net for me without a cause; / yea, without a cause have they dug a pit for my soul.
verses.8: Let a sudden destruction come upon him unawares, and his net that he hath hid catch himself, / that he may fall into his own mischief.
verses.9: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD; / it shall rejoice in his salvation.
verses.10: All my bones shall say, ‘LORD, who is like unto thee, who deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him; / yea, the poor, and him that is in misery from him that spoileth him?’
verses.11: False witnesses did rise up; / they laid to my charge things that I knew not.
verses.12: They rewarded me evil for good, / to the great discomfort of my soul.
verses.13: Nevertheless, when they were sick, I put on sackcloth, and humbled my soul with fasting; / and my prayer shall return into mine own bosom.
verses.14: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother; / I went heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.
verses.15: But when I stumbled they rejoiced and gathered themselves together; / yea, the very abjects and those whom I knew not came together against me, and slandered me without ceasing.
verses.16: Like ungodly men they mocked continually, / and gnashed upon me with their teeth.
verses.17: Lord, how long wilt thou look upon this? / O deliver my soul from the calamities which they bring upon me, and my life from the lions.
verses.18: So will I give thee thanks in the great congregation; / I will praise thee among much people.
verses.19: O Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; / neither let them wink with eyes that hate me without a cause.
verses.20: And why? their communing is not for peace; / but they imagine deceitful words against them that are quiet in the land.
verses.21: They gape upon me with their mouths, / and say, ‘Fie on thee, fie on thee, we saw it with our eyes.’
verses.22: This thou hast seen, O LORD; / hold not thy tongue then; go not far from me, O Lord.
verses.23: Awake, and stand up to judge my quarrel: / avenge thou my cause, my God and my Lord.
verses.24: Give sentence for me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; / and let them not rejoice over me.
verses.25: Let them not say in their hearts, ‘There, there, so would we have it”; / neither let them say, ‘We have devoured him.’
verses.26: Let them be put to confusion and shame together, that rejoice at my trouble: / let them be clothed with rebuke and dishonour, that boast themselves against me.
verses.27: Let them be glad and rejoice, that favour my righteous dealing; / yea, let them say alway, ‘Blessed be the LORD, who hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.’
verses.28: And as for my tongue, it shall be talking of thy righteousness, / and of thy praise all the day long.

verses.1: Sin speaketh to the wicked deep in his heart; / there is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.2: For he flattereth himself in his own sight/ that his iniquity shall not be found out and be hated.
verses.3: The words of his mouth are unrighteous and full of deceit: / he hath left off to behave himself wisely and to do good.
verses.4: He imagineth mischief upon his bed, and setteth himself in no good way; / neither doth he abhor any thing that is evil.
verses.5: Thy mercy, O LORD, reacheth unto the heavens, / and thy faithfulness unto the clouds.
verses.6: Thy righteousness standeth like the strong mountains: / thy judgements are like the great deep.
verses.7: Thou, LORD, shalt save both man and beast; how excellent is thy mercy, O God! / and the children of men shall put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
verses.8: They shall be satisfied with the plenteousness of thy house; / and thou shalt give them drink of thy pleasures, as out of the river.
verses.9: For with thee is the well of life; / and in thy light shall we see light.
verses.10: O Continue forth thy loving-kindness unto them that know thee, / and thy righteousness unto them that are true of heart.
verses.11: O let not the foot of pride come against me; and let not the hand of the ungodly drive me away.
verses.12: There are they fallen, that work wickedness; / they are cast down, and shall not be able to stand.

verses.1: Fret not thyself because of the ungodly; / neither be thou envious against the evil doers.
verses.2: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, / and be withered even as the green herb.
verses.3: Put thou thy trust in the LORD, and be doing good; / dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
verses.4: Delight thou in the LORD, / and he shall give thee thy heart’s desire.
verses.5: Commit thy way unto the LORD, and put thy trust in him, / and he shall bring it to pass.
verses.6: He shall make thy righteousness as clear as the light, / and thy just dealing as the noon-day.
verses.7: Rest in the LORD, and abide patiently upon him: / but grieve not thyself at him whose way doth prosper, against the man that doeth after evil counsels.
verses.8: Leave off from wrath, and let go displeasure: / fret not thyself, else shalt thou be moved to do evil.
verses.9: For wicked doers shall be rooted out; / but they that patiently abide the LORD, those shall inherit the land.
verses.10: Yet a little while, and the ungodly shall be clean gone: / thou shalt look upon his place, and he shall be away.
verses.11: But the meek-spirited shall possess the land, / and shall be refreshed in the multitude of peace.
verses.12: The ungodly seeketh counsel against the just, / and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
verses.13: The Lord shall laugh him to scorn; / for he hath seen that his day is coming.
verses.14: The ungodly have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, / to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as walk uprightly.
verses.15: Their sword shall go through their own heart, / and their bow shall be broken.
verses.16: A Small thing that the righteous hath / is better than great riches of the ungodly.
verses.17: For the arms of the ungodly shall be broken, / but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.
verses.18: The LORD knoweth the days of the godly; and their inheritance shall endure for ever.
verses.19: They shall not be confounded in the perilous time; / and in the days of dearth they shall have enough.
verses.20: As for the ungodly, they shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD shall consume as the flowers of the field; / yea, even as the smoke shall they consume away.
verses.21: The ungodly borroweth, and payeth not again; / but the righteous is merciful and liberal.
verses.22: Such as are blessed of God shall possess the land; / and they that are cursed of him shall be rooted out.
verses.23: The LORD ordereth a good man’s going, / and hath pleasure in his way.
verses.24: Though he fall, he shall not be cast away, / for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.
verses.25: I Have been young, and now am old; / and yet saw I never the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging their bread.
verses.26: The righteous is ever merciful and lendeth; / and his children are blessed.
verses.27: Flee from evil, and do the thing that is good; / and dwell for evermore.
verses.28: For the LORD loveth the thing that is right; / he forsaketh not his that be godly.
verses.29: The unrighteous shall be destroyed forever; / as for the seed of the ungodly, it shall be rooted out.
verses.30: The righteous shall inherit the land, / and dwell therein for ever.
verses.31: The mouth of the righteous is exercised in wisdom, / and his tongue will be talking of judgement.
verses.32: The law of his God is in his heart, / and his goings shall not slide.
verses.33: The ungodly watcheth the righteous, / and seeketh occasion to slay him.
verses.34: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, / nor condemn him when he is judged.
verses.35: Hope thou in the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall promote thee that thou shalt possess the land; / when the ungodly shall perish, thou shalt see it.
verses.36: I myself have seen the ungodly in great power, / and flourishing like a green bay-tree.
verses.37: I went by, and lo, he was gone: / I sought him, but his place could no where be found.
verses.38: Keep innocency, and take heed unto the thing that is right; / for that shall bring a man peace at the last.
verses.39: As for the transgressors, they shall perish together; / and the end of the ungodly is, they shall be rooted out.
verses.40: But the salvation of the righteous cometh of the LORD;/ who is also their refuge in the time of trouble.
verses.41: And the LORD shall stand by them and save them: / he shall deliver them from the ungodly, and shall save them, because they put their trust in him.

verses.1: Put me not to rebuke, O LORD, in thine anger; / neither chasten me in thy heavy displeasure.
verses.2: For thine arrows stick fast in me, / and thy hand presseth me sore.
verses.3: There is no health in my flesh, because of thy displeasure; / neither is there any rest in my bones, by reason of my sin.
verses.4: For my wickednesses are gone over my head, / and are like a sore burden, too heavy for me to bear.
verses.5: My wounds stink and are corrupt, / through my foolishness.
verses.6: I am brought into so great trouble and misery, / that I go mourning all the day long.
verses.7: For my loins are filled with burning, / and there is no sound part in my body.
verses.8: I am feeble, and sore smitten; / I have roared for the very disquietness of my heart.
verses.9: Lord, thou knowest all my desire; / and my groaning is not hid from thee.
verses.10: My heart panteth, my strength hath failed me, / and the light of mine eyes is gone from me.
verses.11: My friends and my neighbours did stand looking upon my trouble, / and my kinsmen stood afar off.
verses.12: They also that sought after my life laid snares for me; / and they that went about to do me evil talked of wickedness, and imagined deceit all the day long.
verses.13: As for me, I was like a deaf man, and heard not; / and as one that is dumb, who doth not open his mouth.
verses.14: I became even as a man that heareth not, / and in whose mouth is no defence.
verses.15: But for thee, O LORD, do I wait; / thou shalt answer for me, O Lord my God.
verses.16: I have required that they, even mine enemies, should not triumph over me; / for when my foot slippeth, they rejoice greatly against me.
verses.17: And I, truly, am ready to fall, / and my heaviness is ever in my sight.
verses.18: For I will confess my wickedness, / and be sorry for my sin.
verses.19: But mine enemies live, and are mighty; / and they that hate me wrongfully are many in number.
verses.20: They also that reward evil for good are against me; / because I follow the thing that is good.
verses.21: Forsake me not, O LORD; / O my God, be not thou far from me.
verses.22: Haste thee to help me, / O Lord God of my salvation.

verses.1: I Said, ‘I will take heed to my ways, / that I offend not in my tongue;
verses.2: I will keep my mouth as it were with a bridle, / while the ungodly is in my sight.’
verses.3: I held my tongue, and spake nothing: / I kept silence, yea, even from good words; but it was pain and grief to me.
verses.4: My heart was hot within me, and while I was thus musing the fire kindled, / and at the last I spake with my tongue:
verses.5: ‘LORD,let me know mine end, and the number of my days: / let me know how frail I am.
verses.6: Behold, thou hast made my days as it were a span long, and mine age is even as nothing in respect of thee; / and verily every man living is altogether vanity.
verses.7: For man walketh as a vain shadow, and disquieteth himself in vain; / he heapeth up riches, and cannot tell who shall gather them.’
verses.8: And now, Lord, what is my hope? / truly my hope is even in thee.
verses.9: Deliver me from all mine offences; / make me not the reproach of the foolish.
verses.10: I became dumb, and opened not my mouth; / for it was thy doing.
verses.11: Take thy plague away from me: / I am even consumed by the means of thy heavy hand.
verses.12: When thou with rebukes dost chasten man for sin, thou makest his beauty to consume away, like as it were a moth fretting a garment; / every man therefore is but vanity.
verses.13: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and with thine ears consider my calling; / hold not thy peace at my tears.
verses.14: For I am a stranger with thee, / and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
verses.15: O spare me a little, that I may recover my strength, / before I go hence, and be no more seen.

verses.1: I Waited patiently for the LORD, / and he inclined unto me, and heard my calling.
verses.2: He brought me also out of the horrible pit, out of the mire and clay, / and set my feet upon the rock, and ordered my goings.
verses.3: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, / even a thanksgiving unto our God.
verses.4: Many shall see it and fear, / and shall put their trust in the LORD.
verses.5: Blessed is the man that hath set his hope in the LORD, / and turned not unto the proud, and to such as go about with lies.
verses.6: O Lord my God, many are the wondrous works which thou hast done, like as be also thy thoughts which are to us-ward; / and there is none to be compared unto thee.
verses.7: If I should declare them and speak of them, / they should be more than I am able to express.
verses.8: Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, / but mine ears hast thou opened.
verses.9: Burnt offering and sacrifice for sin hast thou not required; / then said I, ‘Lo, I come;
verses.10: In the volume of the book it is written of me; I delight to fulfil thy will, O my God; / yea, thy law is within my heart.’
verses.11: I have declared thy righteousness in the great congregation; / lo, I will not refrain my lips, O LORD, and that thou knowest.
verses.12: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; / my talk hath been of thy truth and of thy salvation.
verses.13: I have not kept back thy loving mercy and truth / from the great congregation.
verses.14: Withdraw not thou thy mercies from me, O LORD; / let thy loving-kindness and thy truth alway preserve me.
verses.15: For innumerable troubles are come about me; / my sins have taken such hold upon me that I am not able to look up;
verses.16: Yea, they are more in number than the hairs of my head, / and my heart hath failed me.
verses.17: O Lord, let it be thy pleasure to deliver me; / make haste, O LORD, to help me.
verses.18: Let them be ashamed and confounded together, that seek after my soul to destroy it: / let them be driven backward and put to rebuke, that wish me evil.
verses.19: Let them be desolate, and rewarded with shame, / that say unto me, ‘Fie upon thee, fie upon thee.’
verses.20: Let all those that seek thee be joyful and glad in thee; / and let such as love thy salvation say alway, ‘The LORD be praised.’
verses.21: As for me, I am poor and needy; / but the LORD careth for me.
verses.22: Thou art my helper and redeemer; / make no long tarrying, O my God.

verses.1: Blessed is he that considereth the poor and needy;/ the LORD shall deliver him in the time of trouble.
verses.2: The LORD preserve him, and keep him alive, that he may be blessed in the land; / and deliver not thou him into the will of his enemies.
verses.3: The LORD comfort him when he lieth sick upon his bed; / thou makest all his bed in his sickness.
verses.4: I Said, “LORD, be merciful unto me; / heal my soul, for I have sinned against thee.’
verses.5: Mine enemies speak evil of me, / saying, ‘When shall he die, and his name perish?’
verses.6: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity, / and his heart conceiveth falsehood within himself, and when he goeth forth he telleth it.
verses.7: All mine enemies whisper together against me; / even against me do they imagine this evil.
verses.8: ‘Some deadly thing’, say they, ‘hath laid hold upon him; / and now that he lieth, he shall rise up no more.’
verses.9: Yea, even mine own familiar friend, whom I trusted, / who did also eat of my bread, hath lift up his heel against me.
verses.10: But be thou merciful unto me, O LORD; / raise thou me up, and I shall reward them.
verses.11: By this I know thou favourest me, / that mine enemy doth not triumph against me.
verses.12: And as for me, because of mine innocency thou hast upheld me, / and hast set me before thy face for ever.
verses.13: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, / world without end. Amen and Amen.

verses.1: Like as the hart desireth the water-rooks, / so longeth my soul after thee, O God.
verses.2: My soul is athirst for God, yea, even for the living God: / when shall I come to appear before the presence of God?
verses.3: My tears have been my food day and night, / while all day long they say unto me, ‘ Where is now thy God?’
verses.4: These things will I remember as I pour out my soul within me: / how I went with the multitude, and brought them forth into the house of God,
verses.5: With the voice of praise and thanksgiving, / a multitude keeping holy-day.
verses.6: Why art thou so full of heaviness, O my soul? / and why art thou so disquieted within me?
verses.7: O put thy trust in God, for I will yet give him thanks, / who is the help of my countenance, and my God.
verses.8: My soul is vexed within me; therefore will I remember thee / from the land of Jordan, from Hermon, and the Little Hill.
verses.9: One deep calleth another, because of the noise of thy torrents; / all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
verses.10: The LORD will grant his loving-kindness in the day-time; / and in the night-season will I sing of him, and make my prayer unto the God of my life.
verses.11: I will say unto God my rock, ‘Why hast thou forgotten me? / why go I thus heavily, while the enemy oppresseth me?’
verses.12: My bones are smitten asunder, while mine enemies reproach me, / while they say daily unto me, ‘Where is now thy God?’
verses.13: Why art thou so vexed, O my soul? / and why art thou so disquieted within me?
verses.14: O put thy trust in God, for I will yet give him thanks, / who is the help of my countenance, and my God.

verses.1: Give sentence for me, O God, and defend my cause against an ungodly people; / O deliver me from the deceitful and wicked man.
verses.2: For thou art the God of my strength; why hast thou put me from thee? / and why go I so heavily, while the enemy oppresseth me?
verses.3: O send out thy light and thy truth, that they may lead me, / and bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy dwelling;
verses.4: And that I may go unto the altar of God, even unto the God of my joy and gladness; / and upon the harp will I give thanks unto thee, O God, my God.
verses.5: Why art thou so heavy, O my soul? / and why art thou so disquieted within me?
verses.6: O put thy trust in God, for I will yet give him thanks, / who is the help of my countenance, and my God.

verses.1: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, / what thou hast done in their time of old;
verses.2: How thou didst drive out the nations with thy hand, and plant our fathers in: / how thou didst afflict the peoples, but madest Israel to flourish.
verses.3: For they gat not the land in possession through their own sword, / neither was it their own arm that helped them;
verses.4: But thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance; / because thou hadst a favour unto them.
verses.5: Thou art my King and my God, / who ordainest victory for Jacob.
verses.6: Through thee will we overthrow our enemies, / and in thy Name will we tread them under, that rise up against us.
verses.7: For I will not trust in my bow: / it is not my sword that shall help me.
verses.8: But it is thou that hast saved us from our enemies, / and hast put them to confusion that hate us.
verses.9: We make our boast of God all day long, / and will praise thy Name for ever.
verses.10: But now thou art far off, and puttest us to confusion, / and goest not forth with our armies.
verses.11: Thou makest us to turn our backs upon our enemies, / so that they that hate us spoil our goods.
verses.12: Thou lettest us be eaten up like sheep, / and hast scattered us among the nations.
verses.13: Thou sellest thy people for nought, / and takest no money for them.
verses.14: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, / to be laughed to scorn and had in derision of them that are round about us.
verses.15: Thou makest us to be a by-word among the nations, / and that the peoples shake their heads at us.
verses.16: All day long my disgrace is before me, / and the shame of my face hath covered me,
verses.17: At the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth, / at the sight of the enemy and avenger.
verses.18: And though all this be come upon us, yet do we not forget thee, / nor behave ourselves falsely in thy covenant.
verses.19: Our heart is not turned back, / neither our steps gone out of thy way;
verses.20: No, not when thou hast smitten us into the place of dragons, / and covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.21: If we have forgotten the Name of our God, / and holden up our hands to any strange god,
verses.22: Shall not God search it out? / for he knoweth the very secrets of the heart.
verses.23: For thy sake also are we killed all the daylong, / and are counted as sheep appointed to be slain.
verses.24: Up, Lord, why sleepest thou? / awake, and be not absent from us for ever.
verses.25: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, / and forgettest our misery and trouble?
verses.26: For our soul is brought low, even unto the dust: / our body cleaveth unto the ground.
verses.27: Arise, and help us, / and deliver us for thy mercy’s sake.

verses.1: My heart overfloweth with a good matter: I recite my verses for the king: / my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
verses.2: Thou art fairer than the children of men; / full of grace are thy lips; therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
verses.3: Gird thee with thy sword upon thy thigh, O mighty one, / according to thy glory and thy majesty.
verses.4: And in thy majesty ride on to victory in the cause of truth, and of meekness and righteousness; / and let thy right hand teach thee terrible deeds.
verses.5: Thy arrows are very sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies, / and the peoples shall be subdued unto thee.
verses.6: Thy throne, O God, endureth for ever: / the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.
verses.7: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; / wherefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.8: All thy garments smell of myrrh, aloes, and cassia; / out of ivory palaces stringed instruments make thee glad.
verses.9: Kings’ daughters are among thy honourable women: / upon thy right hand doth stand the queen in a vesture of gold.
verses.10: Hearken, O daughter, consider, and incline thine ear; / forget also thine own people and thy father’s house;
verses.11: So shall the king have pleasure in thy beauty; / since he is thy lord, bow thou down to him.
verses.12: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift: / even the rich among the people shall entreat thy favour.
verses.13: The king’s daughter within the palace is all glorious; / her clothing is of wrought gold.
verses.14: She is brought to the king in raiment of needlework: / the virgins that be her fellows bear her company, and are brought unto thee.
verses.15: With joy and gladness are they led along, / as they enter into the king’s palace.
verses.16: Instead of thy fathers thou shalt have sons, / whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.
verses.17: I will make thy name to be remembered from one generation to another; / therefore shall the peoples praise thee, world without end.

verses.1: God is our hope and strength, / a very present help in trouble.
verses.2: Therefore will we not fear, though the earth be changed, / and though the hills be carried into the midst of the sea;
verses.3: Though the waters thereof rage and swell, / and though the mountains shake at the tempest of the same.
verses.4: The LORD of hosts is with us; / the God of Jacob is our refuge.
verses.5: There is a river, the streams whereof make glad the city of God, / the holy place of the tabernacle of the Most High.
verses.6: God is in the midst of her, therefore shall she not be moved; / God shall help her, and that right early.
verses.7: The nations make much ado, and the kingdoms are moved; / but God uttereth his voice, and the earth doth melt away.
verses.8: The LORD of hosts is with us; / the God of Jacob is our refuge.
verses.9: O Come hither, and behold the works of the LORD, / what wonders he hath wrought upon the earth.
verses.10: He maketh wars to cease in all the world; / he breaketh the bow, and snappeth the spear in sunder, and burneth the chariots in the fire.
verses.11: Be still then, and know that I am God; / I will be exalted among the nations, and I will be exalted in the earth.
verses.12: The LORD of hosts is with us; / the God of Jacob is our refuge.

verses.1: O Clap your hands together, all ye peoples; / O sing unto God with the voice of melody.
verses.2: For the LORD Most High is to be feared; / he is a great King over all the earth.
verses.3: He subdued the peoples under us, / and the nations under our feet.
verses.4: He chose our heritage for us, / even the glorious land of Jacob, whom he loved.
verses.5: God is gone up with a merry noise, / the LORD with the sound of the trumpet.
verses.6: O sing praises, sing praises unto our God; / O sing praises, sing praises unto our King.
verses.7: For God is the King of all the earth: / sing ye praises with understanding.
