verses.14: Turn thee again, O LORD, at the last, / and be gracious unto thy servants.
verses.15: O satisfy us with thy mercy, and that soon: / so shall we rejoice and be glad all the days of our life.
verses.16: Comfort us again according to the time that thou hast afflicted us, / and for the years wherein we have suffered adversity.
verses.17: Show thy servants thy work, / and their children thy glory.
verses.18: And let the glorious majesty of the Lord our God be upon us: / prosper thou the work of our hands upon us, O prosper thou our handy-work.

verses.1: Whoso dwelleth under the defence of the Most High / shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.2: I Will say unto the LORD, ‘Thou art my refuge and my stronghold; / my God in whom I will trust.’
verses.3: For he shall deliver thee from the snare of the hunter, / and from the noisome pestilence.
verses.4: He shall defend thee under his wings, and thou shalt be safe under his feathers; / his faithfulness is a shield and buckler.
verses.5: Thou shalt not be afraid for any terror by night, / nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
verses.6: For the pestilence that walketh in darkness, / nor for the sickness that destroyeth in the noonday.
verses.7: A thousand shall fall beside thee, and ten thousand at thy right hand; / but it shall not come nigh thee.
verses.8: Yea, with thine eyes shalt thou behold, / and see the reward of the ungodly.
verses.9: Because thou hast said, ‘The LORD is my refuge’, / and hast made the Most High thy habitation,
verses.10: There shall no evil happen unto thee, / neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.
verses.11: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, / to keep thee in all thy ways.
verses.12: They shall bear thee in their hands, / that thou hurt not thy foot against a stone.
verses.13: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: / the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under thy feet.
verses.14: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him; / I will set him up, because he hath known my Name.
verses.15: He shall call upon me, and I will hear him: / yea, I am with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and bring him to honour.
verses.16: With long life will I satisfy him, / and show him my salvation.

verses.1: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, / and to sing praises unto thy Name, O thou Most High;
verses.2: To tell of thy loving-kindness in the morning, / and of thy faithfulness in the night-season;
verses.3: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the lute, / with a melody upon the harp.
verses.4: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy works; / and I will rejoice in giving praise for the operations of thy hands.
verses.5: O Lord, how glorious are thy works! / thy thoughts are very deep.
verses.6: An unwise man doth not well consider this, / and a fool doth not understand it:
verses.7: When the ungodly are green as the grass, / and when all the workers of wickedness do flourish,
verses.8: Then shall they be destroyed for ever; / but thou, LORD, art on high for evermore.
verses.9: For lo, thine enemies, O LORD, lo, thine wickedness shall be destroyed.
verses.10: But mine horn hast thou exalted like the horn of a wild ox; / for I am anointed with fresh oil.
verses.11: Mine eye hath seen its desire upon mine enemies, / and mine ears have heard of the doom. of the wicked that rise up against me.
verses.12: The righteous shall flourish like a palmtree, / and shall spread abroad like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.13: Such as are planted in the house of the LORD / shall flourish in the courts of our God.
verses.14: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age, / and shall be full of sap and flourishing;
verses.15: That they may show how true the LORD is; / he is my strength, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

verses.1: The LORD is King, and hath put on glorious apparel: / the LORD hath put on his apparel, and girded himself with strength.
verses.2: He hath made the round world so sure, / that it cannot be moved.
verses.3: Ever since the world began hath thy throne been established: / thou art from everlasting.
verses.4: The floods have lift up, O LORD, the floods have lift up their voice: / the floods lift up their waves.
verses.5: Mightier than the roar of many waters, mightier than the breakers of the sea, / the LORD, who dwelleth on high, is mighty.
verses.6: Thy testimonies, O LORD, are very sure: / holiness becometh thine house for ever.

verses.1: O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongeth, / thou God, to whom vengeance belongeth, show thyself
verses.2: Arise, thou judge of the world, / and reward the proud after their deserving.
verses.3: LORD, how long shall the ungodly, / how long shall the ungodly triumph?
verses.4: How long shall all evil doers speak so disdainfully, / and make such proud boasting?
verses.5: They smite down thy people, O LORD, / and trouble thine heritage.
verses.6: They murder the widow and the stranger, and put the fatherless to death.
verses.7: And yet they say, ‘Tush, the LORD shall not see, / neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.’
verses.8: Take heed, ye unwise among the people: / O ye fools, when will ye understand?
verses.9: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? / or he that made the eye, shall he not see?
verses.10: Or he that chasteneth the nations, shall he not punish? / even he that teacheth man knowledge.
verses.11: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, / that they are but vain.
verses.12: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, / and teachest him out of thy law;
verses.13: That thou mayest give him rest from days of adversity, / until a pit be digged up for the ungodly.
verses.14: For the LORD will not cast off his people, / neither will he forsake his inheritance.
verses.15: For judgement shall turn again unto righteousness; / and all such as are true in heart shall follow it.
verses.16: Who will rise up with me against the wicked? / or who will take my part against the evil doers?
verses.17: If the LORD had not helped me, / my soul would soon have dwelt in Silence.
verses.18: If I say, ‘My foot slippeth’, / thy mercy, O LORD, holdeth me up.
verses.19: In the multitude of the sorrows that I had in my heart, / thy comforts have refreshed my soul.
verses.20: Wilt thou have any thing to do with the wicked rulers, / who make mischief by law?
verses.21: They gather them together against the soul of the righteous, / and condemn the innocent blood.
verses.22: But the LORD hath become my stronghold, / and my God the rock of my refuge.
verses.23: He shall recompense them their wickedness, and destroy them in their own malice; / yea, the LORD our God shall destroy them.

verses.1: O tion. COME, let us sing unto the LORD:/ let us heartily rejoice in the strength of our salva-
verses.2: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, / and show ourselves glad in him with psalms.
verses.3: For the LORD is a great God, / and a great King above all gods.
verses.4: In his hand are all the corners of the earth: / and the strength of the hills is his also.
verses.5: The sea is his, and he made it: / and his hands prepared the dry land.
verses.6: Come, let us worship, and fall down, / and kneel before the LORD our Maker.
verses.7: For he is the Lord our God; / and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand.
verses.8: To-day, O that ye would hear his voice: / ‘Harden not your hearts as in the Provocation, and as in the day of Temptation in the wilderness;
verses.9: When your fathers tempted me, / proved me, and saw my works.
verses.10: Forty years long was I grieved with that generation, and said, / “It is a people that do err in their hearts, for they have not known my ways”;
verses.11: Unto whom I sware in my wrath, / that they should not enter into my rest.”

verses.1: O Sing unto the LORD a new song; / sing unto the LORD, all the whole earth.
verses.2: Sing unto the LORD, and praise his Name; / be telling of his salvation from day to day.
verses.3: Declare his honour among the nations, / and his wonders among all peoples.
verses.4: For the LORD is great, and cannot worthily be praised; / he is more to be feared than all gods.
verses.5: As for all the gods of the peoples, they are but idols; / but it is the LORD that made the heavens.
verses.6: Honour and majesty are before him: / strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
verses.7: Ascribe unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the peoples, / ascribe unto the LORD glory and power.
verses.8: Give unto the LORD the honour due unto his Name; / bring presents and come into his courts.
verses.9: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness; / let the whole earth stand in awe of him.
verses.10: Tell it out among the nations that the LORD is King; / he hath made the round world so fast that it cannot be moved; he shall judge the peoples righteously.
verses.11: Let the heavens rejoice and let the earth be glad; / let the sea make a noise, and all that is therein.
verses.12: Let the field be joyful, and all that is in it; / then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice before the LORD;
verses.13: For he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth, / and with righteousness to judge the world, and the peoples with his truth.

verses.1: The LORD is King, the earth may be glad thereof: / yea, the multitude of the isles may be glad thereof.
verses.2: Clouds and darkness are round about him: / righteousness and judgement are the foundation of his throne.
verses.3: There goeth a fire before him, / and burneth up his enemies on every side.
verses.4: His lightnings gave shine unto the world: / the earth saw it, and was afraid.
verses.5: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, / at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.6: The heavens have declared his righteousness, / and all the peoples have seen his glory.
verses.7: Confounded be all they that worship carved images, and that delight in vain gods: / worship him, all ye gods.
verses.8: Sion heard of it and rejoiced, and the daughters of Judah were glad, / because of thy judgements, O LORD.
verses.9: For thou, LORD, art the Most High over all the earth: / thou art exalted far above all gods.
verses.10: O Ye that love the LORD, see that ye hate the thing which is evil; / the LORD preserveth the souls of his saints; he shall deliver them from the hand of the ungodly.
verses.11: There is sprung up a light for the righteous, / and joyful gladness for such as are true-hearted.
verses.12: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; / and give thanks unto his holy Name.

verses.1: O Sing Unto the LORD a new song; / for he hath done marvellous things.
verses.2: With his own right hand, and with his holy arm, / hath he gotten himself the victory.
verses.3: The LORD hath declared his salvation: / his righteousness hath he openly shown in the sight of the nations.
verses.4: He hath remembered his mercy and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel; / and all the ends of the world have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.5: Show yourselves joyful unto the LORD, all ye lands: / sing, rejoice, and give thanks.
verses.6: Praise the LORD upon the harp: / sing to the harp with a psalm of thanksgiving.
verses.7: With trumpets also and the sound of the horn, / O show yourselves joyful before the LORD, the King.
verses.8: Let the sea make a noise, and all that is therein; / the round world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.9: Let the floods clap their hands, and let the hills be joyful together before the LORD; / for he is come to judge the earth.
verses.10: With righteousness shall he judge the world,/ and the peoples with equity.

verses.1: The LORD is King; let the peoples tremble; / he sitteth upon the cherubim; let the earth be moved.
verses.2: The LORD is great in Sion, / and high above all the peoples.
verses.3: Let them give thanks unto thy Name, / which is great and wonderful; for he is holy.
verses.4: The King’s power loveth judgement; thou dost establish equity: / thou dost execute judgement and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.5: O magnify the LORD our God, / and fall down before his footstool; for he is holy.
verses.6: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among such as call upon his Name: / these called upon the LORD, and he heard them.
verses.7: He spake unto them out of the cloudy pillar; / for they kept his testimonies, and the law that he gave them.
verses.8: Thou heardest them, O LORD our God; / thou forgavest them, O God, though thou didst punish their doings.
verses.9: O magnify the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; / for the LORD our God is holy.

verses.1: O Be joyful in the LORD, all ye lands: / serve the LORD with gladness, and come before his presence with a song.
verses.2: Be ye sure that the LORD he is God; / it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.3: O go your way into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise; / be thankful unto him, and speak good of his Name.
verses.4: For the LORD is gracious, his mercy is everlasting; / and his truth endureth from generation to generation.

verses.1: My song shall be of mercy and judgement: / unto thee,O LORD, will I sing.
verses.2: I will give heed to the way that is perfect: / when wilt thou come unto me?
verses.3: I will walk in the innocence of my heart / within my house.
verses.4: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes; I hate the sins of unfaithfulness; / there shall no such cleave unto me.
verses.5: A froward heart shall depart from me; / I will not know that which is evil.
verses.6: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, / him will I destroy.
verses.7: Whoso hath also an high look and a proud heart, / I will not suffer him.
verses.8: Mine eyes shall look upon such as are faithful in the land, / that they may dwell with me.
verses.9: Whoso leadeth a godly life, / he shall be my servant.
verses.10: There shall no deceitful person dwell in my house: / he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
verses.11: Day by day I will destroy all the ungodly that are in the land, / that I may root out all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.

verses.1: Hear my prayer, O LORD, / and let my crying come unto thee.
verses.2: Hide not thy face from me in the time of my trouble: / incline thine ear unto me; O hear me when I call, and that right soon.
verses.3: For my days consume away like smoke, / and my bones are burnt up as it were a fire-brand.
verses.4: My heart is smitten down, and withered like grass; / for I forget to eat my bread.
verses.5: For the voice of my groaning, / my bones cleave to my flesh.
verses.6: I am become like a pelican in the wilderness, / and like an owl that is in the desert.
verses.7: I watch, and am even as it were a sparrow, / that sitteth alone upon the house-top.
verses.8: Mine enemies revile me all the day long; / and they that are mad against me use my name as a curse.
verses.9: For I have eaten ashes as it were bread, / and mingled my drink with weeping;
verses.10: And that because of thine indignation and wrath; / for thou hast taken me up and cast me down.
verses.11: My days are gone like a shadow; / and I am withered like grass.
verses.12: But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever, / and thy remembrance throughout all generations.
verses.13: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Sion; / for it is time that thou have mercy upon her, yea, the time is come.
verses.14: And why? thy servants think upon her stones, / and it pitieth them to see her in the dust.
verses.15: The nations shall fear thy Name, O LORD, / and all the kings of the earth thy majesty;
verses.16: When the LORD hath built up Sion, / and when he hath appeared in his glory;
verses.17: When he hath turned him unto the prayer of the poor destitute, / and hath not despised their desire.
verses.18: This shall be written for those that come after; / and a people which shall be born shall praise the LORD.
verses.19: For he hath looked down from his sanctuary; / out of the heaven did the LORD behold the earth;
verses.20: That he might hear the mournings of such as are in captivity, / and deliver them that are appointed unto death;
verses.21: That they may declare the Name of the LORD in Sion, / and his worship in Jerusalem;
verses.22: When the peoples are gathered together, / and the kingdoms also, to serve the LORD.
verses.23: He hath brought down my strength in my journey, / and shortened my days.
verses.24: I will say, ‘O my God, take me not away in the midst of mine age; / as for thy years, they endure throughout all generations.’
verses.25: Thou, LORD, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; / and the heavens are the work of thy hands.
verses.26: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: / they all shall wax old as doth a garment;
verses.27: And as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed; / but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.
verses.28: The children of thy servants shall continue, / and their seed shall stand fast in thy sight.

verses.1: Praise the LORD, O my soul: / and all that is within me praise his holy Name.
verses.2: Praise the LORD, O my soul: / and forget not all his benefits;
verses.3: Who forgiveth all thy sin, / and healeth all thine infirmities;
verses.4: Who saveth thy life from destruction, / and crowneth thee with mercy and loving-kindness;
verses.5: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things, / making thee young and lusty as an eagle.
verses.6: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgement / for all them that are oppressed with wrong.
verses.7: He showed his ways unto Moses, / his works unto the children of Israel.
verses.8: The LORD is full of compassion and gracious, / long-suffering, and of great goodness.
verses.9: He will not alway be chiding: / neither keepeth he his anger for ever.
verses.10: He hath not dealt with us after our sins, / nor rewarded us according to our wickednesses.
verses.11: For look how high the heaven is in comparison of the earth, / so great is his mercy also toward them that fear him.
verses.12: Look how wide also the east is from the west, / so far hath he set our sins from us.
verses.13: Yea, like as a father pitieth his own children, / even so is the LORD merciful unto them that fear him.
verses.14: For he knoweth whereof we are made: / he remembereth that we are but dust.
verses.15: The days of man are but as grass; / for he flourisheth as a flower of the field.
verses.16: For as soon as the wind goeth over it, it is gone; / and the place thereof shall know it no more.
verses.17: But the merciful goodness of the LORD endureth for ever and ever upon them that fear him, / and his righteousness unto children’s children;
verses.18: Even unto such as keep his covenant, / and think upon his commandments to do them.
verses.19: The LORD hath established his throne in heaven, / and his kingdom ruleth over all.
verses.20: O praise the LORD, ye angels of his, ye that excel in strength, / ye that fulfil his commandment, and hearken unto the voice of his word.
verses.21: O praise the LORD, all ye his hosts, / ye servants of his that do his pleasure.
verses.22: O speak good of the LORD, all ye works of his, in all places of his dominion: / praise thou the LORD, O my soul.

verses.1: Praise the Lord, O my soul. O Lord My God, thou art become exceeding glorious: / thou art clothed with majesty and honour.
verses.2: Thou deckest thyself with light as it were with garment, / and spreadest out the heavens like curtain;
verses.3: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters, / and maketh the clouds his chariot, and walketh upon the wings of the wind;
verses.4: Who maketh the winds his messengers, / and his ministers a flaming fire.
verses.5: He laid the foundations of the earth, / that it never should move at any time.
verses.6: Thou coveredst it with the deep like as with a garment: / the waters stood above the hills.
verses.7: At thy rebuke they fled: / at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away;
verses.8: They went up as high as the hills, and down to the valleys beneath, / even unto the place which thou hadst appointed for them.
verses.9: Thou didst set them their bounds which they should not pass, / neither turn again to cover the earth.
verses.10: He sendeth the springs into the valleys; / they run among the hills.
verses.11: All beasts of the field drink thereof, / and the wild asses quench their thirst.
verses.12: Beside them the birds of the air have their habitation, / and sing among the branches.
verses.13: He watereth the hills from above; / the earth is filled with the fruit of thy works.
verses.14: He maketh grass to grow for the cattle, / and green herb for the service of men;
verses.15: That he may bring forth food out of the earth, / and wine that maketh glad the heart of man;
verses.16: And oil to make him a cheerful countenance, / and bread to strengthen man’s heart.
verses.17: The trees of the LORD also are full of sap: / even the cedars of Lebanon which he hath planted;
verses.18: Wherein the birds make their nests: / and the fir-trees are a dwelling for the stork.
verses.19: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats, / and so are the stony rocks for the conies.
verses.20: He appointed the moon to mark the seasons: / and the sun knoweth his going down.
verses.21: Thou makest darkness that it may be night, / wherein all the beasts of the forest do move.
verses.22: The lions roar after their prey, / and seek their meat from God.
verses.23: The sun ariseth, and they get them away together, / and lay them down in their dens.
verses.24: Man goeth forth to his work, / and to his labour until the evening.
verses.25: O Lord, how manifold are thy works! / in wisdom hast thou made them all; the earth is full of thy creatures.
verses.26: So is the great and wide sea also, / wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
verses.27: There go the ships; and there is Leviathan, / whom thou hast formed to take his pastime therein.
verses.28: These wait all upon thee, / that thou mayest give them meat in due season.
verses.29: When thou givest it to them they gather it; / and when thou openest thy hand they are filled with good.
verses.30: When thou hidest thy face they are troubled: / when thou takest away their breath they die, and are turned again to their dust.
verses.31: When thou lettest thy breath go forth they are made; / and thou renewest the face of the earth.
verses.32: Let the glorious majesty of the LORD endure for ever; / let the LORD rejoice in his works.
verses.33: The earth shall tremble at the look of him;/ if he do but touch the hills they shall smoke.
verses.34: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: / I will praise my God while I have my being.
verses.35: And so shall my words please him: / my joy shall be in the LORD.
verses.36: Praise thou the LORD, O my soul. / Praise the LORD.

verses.1: O Give thanks unto the LORD, and call upon his Name; / tell the peoples what things he hath done.
verses.2: O let your songs be of him and praise him; / and let your talking be of all his wondrous works.
verses.3: Rejoice in his holy Name: / let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
verses.4: Seek the LORD and his strength: / seek his face evermore.
verses.5: Remember the marvellous works that he hath done, / his wonders, and the judgements of his mouth;
verses.6: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, / ye children of Jacob, his chosen.
verses.7: He is the LORD our God: / his judgements are in all the world.
verses.8: He hath been alway mindful of his covenant, / and the promise that he made to a thousand generations;
verses.9: Even the covenant that he made with Abraham, / and the oath that he sware unto Isaac;
verses.10: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a statute, / and to Israel for an everlasting testament;
verses.11: Saying, ‘Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, / the lot of your inheritance.’
verses.12: When there were yet but a few of them, / and they strangers in the land;
verses.13: What time as they went from one nation to another, / from one kingdom to another people;
verses.14: He suffered no man to do them wrong, / but reproved even kings for their sakes;
verses.15: Saying, ‘Touch not mine anointed, / and do my prophets no harm.’
verses.16: Moreover, he called for a dearth upon the land, / and destroyed all the provision of bread.
verses.17: But he had sent a man before them, / even Joseph, who was sold to be a bond-servant;
verses.18: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: / the iron entered into his soul;
verses.19: Until the time that his word came to pass: / when the promise of the LORD tried him.
verses.20: The king sent and delivered him: / the prince of the people let him go free.
verses.21: He made him lord also of his house, / and ruler of all his substance;
verses.22: That he might instruct his princes after his will, / and teach his senators wisdom.
verses.23: Israel also came into Egypt, / and Jacob was a stranger in the land of Ham.
verses.24: And the LORD increased his people exceedingly, / and made them stronger than their enemies;
verses.25: Whose heart turned to hate his people, / and to deal deceitfully with his servants.
verses.26: Then sent he Moses his servant, / and Aaron whom he had chosen.
verses.27: And he showed his signs among them, / and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.28: He sent darkness and it was dark; / and they were not obedient unto his word.
verses.29: He turned their waters into blood, / and slew their fish.
verses.30: Their land brought forth frogs, / yea, even in their kings’ chambers.
verses.31: He spake the word and there came all manner of flies, / and lice in all their quarters.
verses.32: He gave them hail-stones for rain, / and flames of fire in their land.
verses.33: He smote their vines also and fig-trees, / and destroyed the trees that were in their borders.
verses.34: He spake the word and the locusts came, / and caterpillars innumerable;
verses.35: And did eat up all the grass in their land, / and devoured the fruit of their ground.
verses.36: He smote all the first-born in their land, / even the chief of all their strength.
verses.37: But he brought forth his own people with silver and gold; / and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
verses.38: Egypt was glad at their departing, / for they were afraid of them.
verses.39: He spread out a cloud to be a covering, / and fire to give light in the night-season.
verses.40: At their desire he brought quails, / and filled them with the bread of heaven.
verses.41: He opened the rock of stone, / and the waters flowed out, / so that rivers ran in the dry places.
verses.42: For why? he remembered his holy promise, / and Abraham his servant.
verses.43: And he brought forth his people with joy, / and his chosen with gladness;
verses.44: And gave them the lands of the nations, / and they took the labours of the peoples in possession;
verses.45: That they might keep his statutes, / and observe his laws.

verses.1: O Give thanks unto the LORD, for he is gracious, / and his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.2: Who can express the noble acts of the LORD, / or show forth all his praise?
verses.3: Blessed are they that keep judgement, / and alway do righteousness.
verses.4: Remember me, O LORD, according to the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: / O visit me with thy salvation;
verses.5: That I may see the felicity of thy chosen, / and rejoice in the gladness of thy people, and give thanks with thine inheritance.
verses.6: We have sinned with our fathers; / we have done amiss and dealt wickedly.
verses.7: When our fathers were in Egypt, / they regarded not thy wonders;
verses.8: They kept not thy great goodness in remembrance, / but were disobedient at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
verses.9: Nevertheless, he helped them for his Name’s sake, / that he might make his power to be known.
verses.10: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; / so he led them through the deep as through a wilderness.
verses.11: And he saved them from the adversary’s hand, / and delivered them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.12: As for those that troubled them, the waters overwhelmed them; / there was not one of them left.
verses.13: Then believed they his words, / and sang praise unto him.
verses.14: But within a while they forgat his works, / and would not abide his counsel.
verses.15: But lust came upon them in the wilderness, / and they tempted God in the desert.
verses.16: And he gave them their desire, / but sent leanness withal into their soul.
verses.17: They envied Moses also in the tents, / and Aaron the saint of the LORD.
verses.18: So the earth opened, and swallowed up Dathan, / and covered the congregation of Abiram.
verses.19: And the fire was kindled in their company: / the flame burnt up the ungodly.
verses.20: Israel made a calf in Horeb, / and worshipped the molten image.
verses.21: Thus they changed their Glory / for the likeness of a calf that eateth hay.
verses.22: And they forgat God their Saviour, / who had done so great things in Egypt,
verses.23: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, / and fearful things by the Red Sea.
verses.24: So he said he would have destroyed them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the gap, / to turn away his wrathful indignation, lest he should destroy them.
verses.25: Yea, they thought scorn of that pleasant land, / and gave no credence unto his word;
verses.26: But murmured in their tents, / and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.
verses.27: Then lift he up his hand and sware to them, / that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,
verses.28: And that he would scatter their seed among the nations, / and disperse them in the lands.
verses.29: They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, / and ate the offerings of the dead.
verses.30: Thus they provoked him to anger with their own inventions; / and the plague broke out among them.
verses.31: Then stood up Phinehas and executed judgement, / and so the plague ceased.
verses.32: And that was counted unto him for righteousness, / unto all generations for evermore.
verses.33: They angered him also at the Waters of Strife, / so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes;
verses.34: Because they provoked his spirit, / so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
verses.35: They did not destroy the peoples, / as the LORD commanded them;
verses.36: But were mingled among the nations, / and learned their works.
verses.37: Insomuch that they worshipped their idols, which turned to their own decay: / yea, they offered their sons and their daughters unto demons;
verses.38: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, / whom they offered unto the idols of Canaan; and the land was defiled with blood.
verses.39: Thus were they stained with their own works, / and went a whoring with their own inventions.
verses.40: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, / insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
verses.41: And he gave them over into the hand of the nations; / and they that hated them were lords over them.
verses.42: Their enemies oppressed them, / and had them in subjection.
verses.43: Many a time did he deliver them; / but they rebelled against him with their own inventions, / and were brought down in their wickedness.
verses.44: Nevertheless, he regarded their adversity, / when he heard their complaint.
verses.45: For their sake he thought upon his covenant, / and relented according to the multitude of his mercies.
verses.46: Yea, he made them also to be pitied / by all those that led them away captive.
verses.47: Deliver US, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the nations, / that we may give thanks unto thy holy Name, and make our boast of thy praise.
verses.48: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and world without end: / and let all the people say, ‘Amen.’

verses.1: O Give thanks unto the LORD, for he is gracious, / and his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.2: Let them give thanks whom the LORD hath redeemed, / and delivered from adversity;
verses.3: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east and from the west, / from the north and from the south.
verses.4: They that wandered in the wilderness, even in a desert place, / found no way to a city where men dwelt.
verses.5: Hungry and thirsty, / their soul fainted in them.
verses.6: So they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, / and he delivered them from their distress.
verses.7: He led them forth by the right way, / that they might go to a city where men dwelt.
verses.8: O that men would therefore praise the LORD for his goodness, / and declare the wonders that he doeth for the children of men!
verses.9: For he satisfieth the empty soul, / and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
verses.10: They that sat in darkness and the shadow of death / were fast bound in misery and iron;
verses.11: Because they rebelled against the words of God, / and lightly regarded the counsel of the Most High.
verses.12: He also brought down their heart with hard labour: / they fell down, and there was none to help them.
verses.13: So they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, / and he delivered them from their distress.
verses.14: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, / and brake their bonds in sunder.
verses.15: O that men would therefore praise the LORD for his goodness, / and declare the wonders that he doeth for the children of men!
verses.16: For he hath broken the gates of brass, / and smitten the bars of iron in sunder.
verses.17: They that are foolish are afflicted for their offence, / and because of their wickedness.
verses.18: Their soul abhorred all manner of meat, / and they were even hard at death’s door.
verses.19: So they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, / and he delivered them from their distress.
verses.20: He sent his word and healed them, / and saved them from their destruction.
verses.21: O that men would therefore praise the LORD for his goodness, / and declare the wonders that he doeth for the children of men!
verses.22: That they would offer unto him the sacrifices of thanksgiving, / and tell out his works with gladness!
verses.23: They that go down to the sea in ships, / and occupy their business on the great waters;
verses.24: These men see the works of the LORD, / and his wonders in the deep.
verses.25: For at his word the stormy wind ariseth, / which lifteth up the waves thereof.
verses.26: They are carried up to the heaven, and down again to the deep: / their soul melteth away because of the trouble.
verses.27: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, / and are at their wits’ end.
verses.28: So they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, / and he delivereth them from their distress.
verses.29: For he maketh the storm to cease, / so that the waves thereof are still.
verses.30: Then are they glad, because they are at rest; / and so he bringeth them unto the haven where they would be.
verses.31: O that men would therefore praise the LORD for his goodness, / and declare the wonders that he doeth for the children of men!
verses.32: That they would exalt him also in the congregation of the people, / and praise him in the assembly of the elders!
verses.33: The LORD turneth the floods into a wilderness, / and water-springs into a thirsty ground.
verses.34: A fruitful land maketh he barren, / for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
verses.35: Again, he maketh the wilderness a pool of water, / and water-springs of a dry ground.
verses.36: And there he setteth the hungry, / that they may build them a city to dwell in;
verses.37: That they may sow their land and plant vineyards, / to yield them fruits of increase.
verses.38: He blesseth them, so that they multiply exceedingly, / andsuffereth not their cattle to decrease.
verses.39: And again, when they are minished and brought low, / through oppression, through any plague or trouble;
verses.40: Though he poureth contempt upon princes, / and maketh them to wander out of the way in the wilderness;
verses.41: Yet helpeth he the poor out of misery, / and maketh him households like a flock of sheep.
verses.42: The righteous shall see this and rejoice; / and the mouth of all wickedness shall be stopped.
verses.43: Whoso is wise will ponder these things; / and they shall understand the loving-kindness of the LORD.

verses.1: O God, my heart is ready, my heart is ready; / I will sing and give praise with the best member that I have.
verses.2: Awake, thou lute and harp: / I myself will awake the dawn.
verses.3: I will give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the peoples; / I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
verses.4: For thy mercy is great above the heavens, / and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.
verses.5: Set up thyself, O God, above the heavens, / and thy glory above all the earth.
verses.6: That thy beloved may be delivered, / save with thy right hand, and hear thou me.
verses.7: God hath spoken in his holiness: / ‘I will rejoice, and divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.8: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; / Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre;
verses.9: Moab is my wash-pot; upon Edom will I cast out my shoe; / over Philistia will I shout in triumph.’
verses.10: Who will lead me into the strong city? / who will bring me into Edom?
verses.11: Hast not thou forsaken us, O God? / and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
verses.12: O help us against the enemy; / for vain is the help of man.
verses.13: Through God we shall do great acts; / and it is he that shall tread down our enemies.

verses.1: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise; / for the mouth of the ungodly, yea, the mouth of the deceitful is opened upon me.
verses.2: They have spoken against me with false tongues: / they compassed me about also with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
verses.3: For the love that I had unto them, lo, they take now my contrary part; / but I give myself unto prayer.
verses.4: Thus have they rewarded me evil for good, / and hatred for my good will.
verses.5: But deal thou with me, O Lord GOD, according to thy Name; / for sweet is thy mercy.
verses.6: O deliver me, for I am helpless and poor, / and my heart is wounded within me.
verses.7: I go hence like the shadow that declineth, / and am driven away as the locust.
verses.8: My knees are weak through fasting; / my flesh is dried up for want of fatness.
verses.9: I am become also a reproach unto them: / they that look upon me shake their heads.
verses.10: Help me, O LORD my God; / O save me according to thy mercy;
verses.11: And they shall know, how that this is thy hand, / and that thou, LORD, hast done it.
verses.12: Though they curse, yet bless thou; / and let them be confounded that rise up against me; but thy servant shall rejoice.
verses.13: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame; / and let them cover themselves with their own confusion as with a cloak.
verses.14: As for me, I will give great thanks unto the LORD with my mouth, / and praise him among the multitude.
verses.15: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, / to save his soul from unrighteous judges.

verses.1: The LORD said unto my lord, / ‘Sit thou on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.’
verses.2: The LORD shall send the rod of thy power out of Sion: / be thou ruler, even in the midst among thine enemies.
verses.3: Thy people offer themselves willingly in the day of thy power; / in the beauties of holiness, from the womb of the morning, thou hast the dew of thy youth.
verses.4: The LORD sware and will not repent, / ‘Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.’
verses.5: The Lord upon thy right hand / shall smite even kings in the day of his wrath.
verses.6: He shall judge among the nations, and he shall fill them with the bodies of the slain; / yea, he shall smite the heads over many countries.
verses.7: He shall drink of the brook in the way; / therefore shall he lift up his head.

verses.1: I Will give thanks unto the LORD with my whole heart, / in the council of the faithful and in the congregation.
verses.2: The works of the LORD are great, / sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
verses.3: His work is worthy to be praised and had in honour; / and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.4: The merciful and gracious LORD hath so done his marvellous works, / that they ought to be had in remembrance.
verses.5: He hath given meat unto them that fear him; / he shall ever be mindful of his covenant.
verses.6: He hath showed his people the power of his works, / in giving them the heritage of the nations.
verses.7: The works of his hands are verity and judgement; / all his precepts are sure;
verses.8: They stand fast for ever and ever, / and are done in truth and equity.
verses.9: He sent redemption unto his people; / he hath commanded his covenant for ever; holy and reverend is his Name.
verses.10: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; / a good understanding have all they that do thereafter; his praise endureth for ever.

verses.1: Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, / that hath great delight in his commandments.
verses.2: His seed shall be mighty upon earth; / the generation of the faithful shall be blessed.
verses.3: Riches and plenteousness shall be in his house; / and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.4: Unto the upright there ariseth up light in the darkness; / he is merciful, loving, and righteous.
verses.5: It is well with the man that is merciful and lendeth, / and ordereth his affairs with justice.
verses.6: For he shall never be moved: / and the righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.
verses.7: He will not be afraid of any evil tidings; / for his heart standeth fast and believeth in the LORD.
verses.8: His heart is established and will not shrink, / until he see his desire upon his enemies.
verses.9: He hath dispersed abroad and given to the poor, / and his righteousness remaineth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
verses.10: The ungodly shall see it, and it shall grieve him: / he shall gnash with his teeth and consume away; the desire of the ungodly shall perish.

verses.1: Praise the LORD, ye servants; / O praise the Name of the LORD.
verses.2: Blessed be the Name of the LORD / from this time forth for evermore.
verses.3: The LORD’ S Name is to be praised / from the rising up of the sun unto the going down of the same.
verses.4: The LORD is high above all nations, / and his glory above the heavens.
verses.5: Who is like unto the LORD our God, / that hath his dwelling so high,
verses.6: And yet humbleth himself to behold / the things that are in heaven and earth?
verses.7: He taketh up the poor out of the dust, / and lifteth the needy out of the mire;
verses.8: That he may set him with the princes, / even with the princes of his people.
verses.9: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, / and to be a joyful mother of children.

verses.1: When Israel came out of Egypt, / and the house of Jacob from among the strange people,
verses.2: Judah was his sanctuary, / and Israel his dominion.
verses.3: The sea saw that, and fled; / Jordan was driven back.
verses.4: The mountains skipped like rams, / and the little hills like young sheep.
verses.5: What aileth thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest, / and thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?
verses.6: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams, / and ye little hills, like young sheep?
verses.7: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord: / at the presence of the God of Jacob;
verses.8: Who turned the hard rock into a standing water, / and the flint-stone into a springing well.

verses.1: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy Name give the praise, / for thy loving mercy and for thy truth’s sake.
verses.2: Wherefore should the nations say, / ‘Where is now their God?’
verses.3: As for our God, he is in heaven: / he hath done whatsoever pleased him.
verses.4: Their idols are silver and gold, / even the work of men’s hands.
verses.5: They have mouths, and speak not: / eyes have they, and see not.
verses.6: They have ears, and hear not: / noses have they, and smell not.
verses.7: They have hands, and handle not; feet have they, and walk not: / neither speak they through their throat.
verses.8: They that make them are like unto them; / and so are all such as put their trust in them.
verses.9: But thou, house of Israel, trust thou in the LORD: / he is their succour and defence.
verses.10: Ye house of Aaron, put your trust in the LORD: / he is their helper and defender.
verses.11: Ye that fear the LORD, put your trust in the LORD: / he is their helper and defender.
verses.12: The LORD hath been mindful of us, and he shall bless us: / even he shall bless the house of Israel; he shall bless the house of Aaron.
verses.13: He shall bless them that fear the LORD, / both small and great.
verses.14: May the LORD increase you more and more, / you and your children.
verses.15: Blessed be ye of the LORD, / who hath made heaven and earth.
verses.16: All the whole heavens are the LORD, / but the earth hath he given to the children of men.
verses.17: The dead praise not thee, O LORD, / neither all they that go down into Silence.
verses.18: But we will praise the LORD, / from this time forth for evermore. Praise the LORD.

verses.1: My delight is in the LORD, / because he hath heard the voice of my prayer;
verses.2: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, / therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
verses.3: The cords of death compassed me round about, / and the pains of hell gat hold upon me.
verses.4: I found trouble and heaviness, and I called upon the Name of the LORD: / ‘O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.’
verses.5: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; / yea, our God is merciful.
verses.6: The LORD preserveth the simple: / I was in misery and he helped me.
verses.7: Turn again then unto thy rest, O my soul; / for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
verses.8: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, / mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
verses.9: I will walk before the LORD / in the land of the living.
verses.10: I Trusted even when I spake; but I was sore troubled: / I said in my haste, ‘All men are liars.’
verses.11: What reward shall I give unto the LORD / for all the benefits that he hath done unto me?
verses.12: I will take the cup of salvation, / and call upon the Name of the LORD.
verses.13: I will pay my vows unto the LORD / in the presence of all his people.
verses.14: Right dear in the sight of the LORD / is the death of his saints.
verses.15: Behold, O LORD, how that I am thy servant: / I am thy servant and the son of thy handmaid; thou hast broken my bonds in sunder.
verses.16: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, / and will call upon the Name of the LORD.
verses.17: I will pay my vows unto the LORD / in the presence of all his people;
verses.18: Even in the courts of the LORD’S house, / and in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise the LORD.

verses.1: O Praise the LORD, all ye nations: / laud him, all ye peoples.
verses.2: For his merciful kindness is ever more and more towards us: / and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise the LORD.

verses.1: O Give thanks unto the LORD, for he is gracious: / because his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.2: Let Israel now confess that he is gracious, / and that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.3: Let the house of Aaron now confess / that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.4: Yea, let them now that fear the LORD confess / that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.5: I Called upon the LORD in trouble; / and the LORD heard me and set me free.
verses.6: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: / what can man do unto me?
verses.7: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: / therefore shall I see my desire upon mine enemies.
verses.8: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put any confidence in man.
verses.9: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put any confidence in princes.
verses.10: All nations compassed me round about; / but in the Name of the LORD did I destroy them.
verses.11: They kept me in on every side, they kept me in, I say, on every side; / but in the Name of the LORD did I destroy them.
verses.12: They came about me like bees, and blazed up even as the fire among the thorns; / but in the Name of the LORD did I destroy them.
verses.13: Thou hast thrust sore at me, that I might fall; / but the LORD was my help.
verses.14: The LORD is My strength and my song, / and is become my salvation.
verses.15: The voice of joy and health is in the dwellings of the righteous: / the right hand of the LORD bringeth mighty things to pass.
verses.16: The right hand of the LORD is exalted: / the right hand of the LORD bringeth mighty things to pass.
verses.17: I shall not die, but live, / and declare the works of the LORD.
verses.18: The LORD hath chastened and corrected me; / but he hath not given me over unto death.
verses.19: Open to me the gates of righteousness, / that I may go into them and give thanks unto the LORD.
verses.20: This is the gate of the LORD: / the righteous shall enter into it.
verses.21: I will thank thee, for thou hast heard me, / and art become my salvation.
verses.22: The same stone which the builders refused / is become the head-stone in the corner.
verses.23: This is the LORD’ S doing, / and it is marvellous in our eyes.
verses.24: This is the day which the LORD hath made; / we will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.25: Help us now, O LORD: / O LORD, send us now prosperity.
verses.26: Blessed is he that cometh in the Name of the LORD:/ we bless you from the house of the LORD.
verses.27: The LORD is God, and he hath given us light: / set in order the procession with branches, yea, even up to the horns of the altar.
verses.28: Thou art my God, and I will thank thee: / thou art my God, and I will praise thee.
verses.29: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is gracious: / for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.1: Blessed are those that are undefiled in the way, / and walk in the law of the LORD.
verses.2: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, / and seek him with their whole heart;
verses.3: Even they that do no wickedness, / but walk in his ways.
verses.4: Thou hast ordained thy precepts / that we should diligently keep them.
verses.5: O that my ways were made so direct / that I might keep thy statutes!
verses.6: So shall I not be confounded, / while I have respect unto all thy commandments.
verses.7: I will thank thee with an unfeigned heart, / when I shall have learned the judgements of thy righteousness.
verses.8: I will keep thy statutes: / O forsake me not utterly.
verses.9: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? / even by ruling himself after thy word.
verses.10: With my whole heart have I sought thee; / O let me not go astray from thy commandments.
verses.11: Thy word have I hid within my heart, / that I should not sin against thee.
verses.12: Blessed art thou, O LORD;/ O teach me thy statutes.
verses.13: With my lips have I been telling / of all the judgements of thy mouth.
verses.14: I have had as great delight in the way of thy testimonies, / as in all manner of riches.
verses.15: I will meditate upon thy precepts, / and have respect unto thy ways.
verses.16: My delight shall be in thy statutes, / and I will not forget thy word.
verses.17: O Do well unto thy servant, / that I may live, and keep thy word.
verses.18: Open thou mine eyes, / that I may see the wondrous things of thy law.
verses.19: I am a sojourner upon earth: / O hide not thy commandments from me.
verses.20: My soul breaketh out for the very fervent desire / that it hath alway unto thy judgements.
verses.21: Thou hast rebuked the proud, / and cursed are they that do err from thy commandments.
verses.22: O turn from me shame and rebuke; / for I have kept thy testimonies.
verses.23: Princes also did sit and speak against me; / but thy servant is occupied in thy statutes.
verses.24: For thy testimonies are my delight, / and my counsellors.
verses.25: My soul cleaveth to the dust; / O quicken thou me, according to thy word.
verses.26: I have acknowledged my ways, and thou heardest me: / O teach me thy statutes.
verses.27: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts; / and so shall I meditate upon thy wondrous works.
verses.28: My soul melteth away for very heaviness: / comfort thou me according unto thy word.
verses.29: Take from me the way of lying, / and graciously grant me thy law.
verses.30: I have chosen the way of truth, / and thy judgements have I laid before me.
verses.31: I cleave unto thy testimonies: / O LORD, confound me not.
verses.32: I will run the way of thy commandments, / when thou hast set my heart at liberty.
verses.33: Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes, / and I shall keep it unto the end.
verses.34: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law: / yea, I shall keep it with my whole heart.
verses.35: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; / for therein is my desire.
verses.36: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, / and not to covetousness.
verses.37: O turn away mine eyes, lest they behold vanity, / and quicken thou me in thy ways.
verses.38: O stablish thy word to thy servant, / that I may fear thee.
verses.39: Take away the reproach that I am afraid of; / for thy judgements are good.
verses.40: Behold, I have longed for thy precepts: / O quicken me in thy righteousness.
verses.41: Let thy loving mercy come also unto me, O LORD, / even thy salvation according unto thy word.
verses.42: So shall I make answer unto my blasphemers; / for my trust is in thy word.
verses.43: O take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; / for my hope is in thy judgements.
verses.44: So shall I alway keep thy law, / yea, for ever and ever.
verses.45: And I will walk at liberty; / for I seek thy precepts.
verses.46: I will speak of thy testimonies also, even before kings, / and will not be ashamed.
verses.47: And my delight shall be in thy commandments, / which I have loved.
verses.48: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; / and my study shall be in thy statutes.
verses.49: O Think upon thy word as concerning thy servant, / wherein thou hast caused me to put my trust.
verses.50: The same is my comfort in my trouble; / for thy word hath quickened me.
verses.51: The proud have had me exceedingly in derision; / yet have I not shrinked from thy law.
verses.52: For I remembered thine everlasting judgements, O LORD, / and received comfort.
verses.53: Horror hath taken hold of me, / because of the ungodly that forsake thy law.
verses.54: Thy statutes have been my songs / in the house of my pilgrimage.
verses.55: I have thought upon thy Name, O LORD, in the night-season, / and have kept thy law.
verses.56: This I have had, / because I kept thy precepts.
verses.57: Thou art my portion, O LORD: / I have promised to keep thy words.
verses.58: I made my humble petition in thy presence with my whole heart: / O be merciful unto me, according to thy word.
verses.59: I called mine own ways to remembrance, / and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
verses.60: I made haste and prolonged not the time, / to keep thy commandments.
verses.61: The cords of the ungodly have encompassed me; / but I have not forgotten thy law.
verses.62: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee, / because of thy righteous judgements.
verses.63: I am a companion of all them that fear thee / and keep thy precepts.
verses.64: The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: / O teach me thy statutes.
verses.65: O Lord, thou hast dealt graciously with thy servant, / according unto thy word.
verses.66: O teach me true understanding and knowledge; / for I have believed thy commandments.
verses.67: Before I was troubled, I went wrong; / but now have I kept thy word.
verses.68: Thou art good and gracious: / O teach me thy statutes.
verses.69: The proud have imagined a lie against me; / but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.
verses.70: Their heart is as fat as brawn; / but my delight hath been in thy law.
verses.71: It is good for me that I have been in trouble, / that I may learn thy statutes.
verses.72: The law of thy mouth is dearer unto me / than thousands of gold and silver.
verses.73: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: / O give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
verses.74: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; / because I have put my trust in thy word.
verses.75: I know, O LORD, that thy judgements are right, / and that thou of very faithfulness hast caused me to be troubled.
verses.76: O let thy merciful kindness be my comfort, / according to thy word unto thy servant.
verses.77: O let thy loving mercies come unto me, that I may live; / for thy law is my delight.
verses.78: Let the proud be confounded, for they go wickedly about to destroy me; / but I will be occupied in thy precepts.
verses.79: Let such as fear thee turn unto me, / even they that know thy testimonies.
verses.80: O let my heart be sound in thy statutes, / that I be not ashamed.
verses.81: My soul longeth for thy salvation, / and I have a good hope because of thy word.
verses.82: Mine eyes long sore for thy word, / saying, ‘O when wilt thou comfort me?’
verses.83: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; / yet do I not forget thy statutes.
verses.84: How many are the days of thy servant? / when wilt thou do judgement on them that persecute me?
verses.85: The proud have digged pits for me, / who are not after thy law.
verses.86: All thy commandments are true: / they persecute me falsely; O be thou my help.
verses.87: They had almost made an end of me upon earth; / but I forsook not thy precepts.
verses.88: O quicken me after thy loving-kindness; / and so shall I keep the testimonies of thy mouth.
verses.89: O Lord, thy word / standeth fast for ever in the heavens.
verses.90: Thy truth also remaineth from one generation to another: / thou hast laid the foundation of the earth, and it abideth.
verses.91: They continue this day according to thine ordinances; / for all things serve thee.
verses.92: If my delight had not been in thy law, / I should have perished in my trouble.
verses.93: I will never forget thy precepts; / for with them thou hast quickened me.
verses.94: I am thine, O save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
verses.95: The ungodly laid wait for me to destroy me; / but I will consider thy testimonies.
verses.96: I see that all things come to an end; / but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
verses.97: Lord, what love have I unto thy law! / all the day long is my study in it.
verses.98: Thy commandment maketh me wiser than mine enemies; / for it is ever with me.
verses.99: I have more understanding than all my teachers; / for thy testimonies are my study.
verses.100: I have more discernment than the aged; / because I keep thy precepts.
verses.101: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, / that I may keep thy word.
verses.102: I have not shrunk from thy judgements; / for thou teachest me.
verses.103: O how sweet are thy words unto my throat,/ yea, sweeter than honey unto my mouth!
verses.104: Through thy precepts I get understanding: / therefore I hate all evil ways.
verses.105: Thy word is a lantern unto my feet, / and a light unto my path.
verses.106: I have sworn, and am stedfastly purposed, / to keep thy righteous judgements.
verses.107: I am troubled above measure: / quicken me, O LORD, according to thy word.
verses.108: Let the free-will offerings of my mouth please thee, O LORD, / and teach me thy judgements.
verses.109: My life is alway in my hand; / yet do I not forget thy law.
verses.110: The ungodly have laid a snare for me; / but yet I swerved not from thy precepts.
verses.111: Thy testimonies have I claimed as mine heritage for ever; / and why? they are the very joy of my heart.
verses.112: I have applied my heart to fulfil thy statutes, / alway, even unto the end.
verses.113: I Hate double-minded men; / but thy law do I love.
verses.114: Thou art my defence and shield: / and my trust is in thy word.
verses.115: Away from me, ye wicked, / that I may keep the commandments of my God.
verses.116: O stablish me according to thy word, that I may live; / and let me not be disappointed of my hope.
verses.117: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe; / yea, my delight shall be ever in thy statutes.
verses.118: Thou hast trodden down all them that depart from thy statutes; / for they imagine but deceit.
verses.119: Thou puttest away all the ungodly of the earth like dross; / therefore I love thy testimonies.
verses.120: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; / and I am afraid of thy judgements.
verses.121: I Have done the thing that is lawful and right: / O give me not over unto mine oppressors.
verses.122: Be thou surety for thy servant to do him good, / that the proud do me no wrong.
verses.123: Mine eyes are wasted away with looking for thy salvation, / and for the word of thy righteousness.
verses.124: O deal with thy servant according unto thy loving mercy, / and teach me thy statutes.
verses.125: I am thy servant; O grant me understanding, / that I may know thy testimonies.
verses.126: It is time for thee, LORD, to lay to thine hand; / for they have destroyed thy law.
verses.127: For I love thy commandments / above gold, yea above fine gold.
verses.128: Therefore I hold all thy precepts to be right; / and all false ways I utterly abhor.
verses.129: Thy testimonies are wonderful; / therefore doth my soul keep them.
verses.130: When thy word goeth forth, / it giveth light and understanding unto the simple.
verses.131: I opened my mouth and drewin my breath; / for my delight was in thy commandments.
verses.132: O look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, / as thou art wont to do unto those that love thy Name.
verses.133: Order my steps in thy word; / and so shall no wickedness have dominion over me.
verses.134: O deliver me from the wrongful dealings of men; / and so shall I keep thy precepts.
verses.135: Show the light of thy countenance upon thy servant, / and teach me thy statutes.
verses.136: Mine eyes gush out with water, / because men keep not thy law.
verses.137: Righteous art thou, O LORD, / and true are thy judgements.
verses.138: The testimonies that thou hast commanded / are exceeding righteous and true.
verses.139: My zeal hath even consumed me; / because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
verses.140: Thy word is tried to the uttermost, / and thy servant loveth it.
verses.141: I am small and of no reputation; / yet do I not forget thy precepts.
verses.142: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, / and thy law is the truth.
verses.143: Trouble and heaviness have taken hold upon me; / yet is my delight in thy commandments.
verses.144: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: / O grant me understanding, and I shall live.
verses.145: I Call with my whole heart: / hear me, O LORD; I will keep thy statutes.
verses.146: Yea, even unto thee do I call; O help me, / and I shall keep thy testimonies.
verses.147: Early in the morning do I cry unto thee; / for in thy word is my trust.
verses.148: Mine eyes forestall the night-watches, / that I might be occupied in thy words.
verses.149: Hear my voice, O LORD, according unto thy loving-kindness: / quicken me, according as thou art wont.
verses.150: They draw nigh that of malice persecute me, / and are far from thy law.
verses.151: Thou art nigh at hand, O LORD; / and all thy commandments are true.
verses.152: As concerning thy testimonies, I have known long since, / that thou hast grounded them for ever.
verses.153: O Consider mine adversity, and deliver me, / for I do not forget thy law.
verses.154: Plead thou my cause, and redeem me: / quicken me, according to thy word.
verses.155: Salvation is far from the ungodly; / for they regard not thy statutes.
verses.156: Great is thy mercy, O LORD: / quicken me, according to thy judgements.
verses.157: Many there are that trouble me and persecute me; / yet do I not swerve from thy testimonies.
verses.158: It grieveth me when I see the transgressors; / because they keep not thy word.
verses.159: Consider, O LORD, how I love thy precepts: / O quicken me, according to thy lovingkindness.
verses.160: Thy word is altogether true: / all the judgements of thy righteousness endure for evermore.
verses.161: Princes have persecuted me without a cause; / but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
verses.162: I am as glad of thy word, / as one that findeth great spoil.
verses.163: As for lies, I hate and abhor them; / but thy law do I love.
verses.164: Seven times a day do I praise thee, / because of thy righteous judgements.
verses.165: Great is the peace that they have who love thy law; / and nothing shall lead them astray.
verses.166: LORD, I have looked for thy saving health, / and done after thy commandments.
verses.167: My soul hath kept thy testimonies, / and loved them exceedingly.
verses.168: I have kept thy precepts and testimonies; / for all my ways are before thee.
verses.169: Let my cry come before thee, O LORD: / give me understanding, according to thy word.
verses.170: Let my supplication come before thee: / deliver me, according to thy word.
verses.171: My lips shall speak of thy praise, / because thou teachest me thy statutes.
verses.172: Yea, my tongue shall sing of thy word; / for all thy commandments are righteous.
verses.173: Let thy hand help me; / for I have chosen thy precepts.
verses.174: I have longed for thy saving health, O LORD; / and in thy law is my delight.
verses.175: O let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; / and let thy judgements help me.
verses.176: I have gone astray like a sheep that is lost; / O seek thy servant, for I do not forget thy commandments.

verses.1: When I was in trouble I called upon the LORD, / and he hearkened unto me.
verses.2: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, / and from a deceitful tongue.
verses.3: What reward shall be given or done unto thee, thou false tongue? / even sharp arrows of the mighty, with hot burning coals.
verses.4: Woe is me that I am constrained to dwell with Meshech, / and to have my habitation among the tents of Kedar!
verses.5: My soul hath long dwelt among them / that are enemies unto peace.
verses.6: I labour for peace, but when I speak unto them thereof, / they make them ready to battle.

verses.1: I Will lift up mine eyes unto the hills: / O whence cometh my help?
verses.2: My help cometh even from the LORD, / who hath made heaven and earth.
verses.3: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: / and he that keepeth thee will not sleep.
verses.4: Behold, he that keepeth Israel / shall neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.5: The LORD himself is thy keeper: / the LORD is thy defence upon thy right hand;
verses.6: So that the sun shall not burn thee by day, / neither the moon by night.
verses.7: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: / yea, it is even he that shall keep thy soul.
verses.8: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in, / from this time forth for evermore.

verses.1: I Was glad when they said unto me, / ‘We will go unto the house of the LORD.’
verses.2: Behold, our feet now stand / within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
verses.3: Jerusalem is built as a city / that is at unity in itself;
verses.4: Whither the tribes go up, even the tribes of the LORD, / as was decreed for Israel, to give thanks unto the Name of the LORD.
verses.5: For there were set the thrones for judgement, / even the thrones of the house of David.
verses.6: O Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: / may they prosper that love thee.
verses.7: Peace be within thy walls, / and plenteousness within thy palaces.
verses.8: For my brethren and companions’ sakes, / I will wish thee prosperity.
verses.9: Yea, because of the house of the LORD our God, / I will seek to do thee good.

verses.1: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, / O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
verses.2: Behold, even as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, / and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress,
verses.3: Even so our eyes wait upon the LORD our God, / until he have mercy upon us.
verses.4: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us; / for we are utterly despised.
verses.5: Our soul is filled with the scornful reproof of the wealthy, / and with the despitefulness of the proud.

verses.1: If the LORD himself had not been on our side, now may Israel say; / if the LORD himself had not been on our side, when men rose up against us;
verses.2: They had swallowed us up alive, / when they were so wrathfully displeased at us;
verses.3: Then the waters had drowned us, / and the torrent had gone over our soul;
verses.4: Yea, then the raging waters / had gone even over our soul.
verses.5: But praised be the LORD, / who hath not given us over for a prey unto their teeth.
verses.6: Our soul is escaped even as a bird out of the snare of the fowler: / the snare is broken, and we are delivered.
verses.7: Our help standeth in the Name of the LORD, / who hath made heaven and earth.

verses.1: They that put their trust in the LORD are even as the mount Sion, / which may not be removed, but standeth fast for ever.
verses.2: The hills stand about Jerusalem: / even so standeth the LORD round about his people, from this time forth for evermore.
verses.3: For the sceptre of the ungodly shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; / lest the righteous put their hand unto wickedness.
verses.4: Do well, O LORD, Unto those that are good, / and unto them that are true of heart.
verses.5: As for such as turn aside to their own crooked ways, / the LORD shall lead them forth with the evil doers; but peace be upon Israel.

verses.1: When the LORD restored the fortunes of Sion, / then were we like unto them that dream.
verses.2: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, / and our tongue with joy.
verses.3: Then said they among the nations, / ‘The LORD hath done great things for them.’
verses.4: Yea, the LORD hath done great things for us already; / whereof we rejoice.
verses.5: Restore our fortunes, O LORD, / as the rivers in the South.
verses.6: They that sow in tears / shall reap in joy.
verses.7: He that now goeth on his way weeping, and beareth forth his seed, / shall doubtless come again with joy, and bring his sheaves with him.

verses.1: Except the LORD build the house, / their labour is but lost that build it.
verses.2: Except the LORD keep the city, / the watchman keepeth vigil but in vain.
verses.3: It is but lost labour that ye haste to rise up early, and so late take rest, and eat the bread of carefulness; / for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
verses.4: Lo, children and the fruit of the womb / are an heritage and gift that cometh of the LORD.
verses.5: Like as the arrows in the hand of the giant, / even so are the children of one’s youth.
verses.6: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: / they shall not be ashamed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.

verses.1: Blessed are all they that fear the LORD, / and walk in his ways.
verses.2: For thou shalt eat the labour of thy hands: / O well is it with thee, and happy shalt thou be.
verses.3: Thy wife shall be as the fruitful vine, / within the walls of thine house;
verses.4: Thy children like the olive-branches, / round about thy table.
verses.5: Lo, thus shall the man be blessed, / that feareth the LORD.
verses.6: The LORD from out of Sion shall so bless thee, / that thou shalt see Jerusalem in prosperity all thy life long.
verses.7: Yea, thou shalt see thy children’s children, / and peace upon Israel.

verses.1: Many a time have they fought against me from my youth up, / may Israel now say;
verses.2: Yea, many a time have they vexed me from my youth up; / but they have not prevailed against me.
verses.3: The plowers plowed upon my back, / and made long furrows.
verses.4: But the LORD is righteous, / and he hath hewn the snares of the ungodly in pieces.
verses.5: Let them be confounded and turned backward, / as many as have evil will at Sion.
verses.6: Let them be even as the grass growing upon the house-tops, / which withereth afore it be plucked up;
verses.7: Whereof the mower filleth not his hand, / neither he that bindeth up the sheaves his bosom.
verses.8: So that they that go by say not so much as, ‘The blessing of the LORD be upon you: / we bless you in the Name of the LORD.’

verses.1: Out of the deep have I called unto thee, O LORD; / Lord, hear my voice.
verses.2: O let thine ears consider well / the voice of my complaint.
verses.3: If thou, LORD, wilt be extreme to mark what is done amiss, / O Lord, who may abide it?
verses.4: But there is forgiveness with thee; / therefore shalt thou be feared.
verses.5: I Look for the LORD; my soul doth wait for him: / in his word is my trust.
verses.6: My soul looketh for the Lord more than watchmen for the morning, / yea, more than watchmen for the morning.
verses.7: O Israel, trust in the LORD, for with the LORD there is mercy, / and with him is plenteous redemption.
verses.8: And he shall redeem Israel / from all his sins.

verses.1: Lord I am not high-minded: / I have no proud looks.
verses.2: I do not exercise myself in great matters, / which are too high for me.
verses.3: But I calm my soul and keep it quiet, like a weaned child with his mother: / yea, my soul is even as a weaned child.
verses.4: O Israel, trust in the LORD, / from this time forth for evermore.

verses.1: Lord, remember David, / and all his trouble;
verses.2: How he sware unto the LORD, / and vowed a vow unto the Mighty One of Jacob:
verses.3: ‘I will not come within the tabernacle of mine house, / nor climb up into my bed;
verses.4: I will not suffer mine eyes to sleep, / nor mine eyelids to slumber;
verses.5: Until I find out a place for the LORD, / an habitation for the Mighty One of Jacob.’
verses.6: Lo, we heard of the same at Ephrathah, / and found it in the fields of the Wood.
verses.7: We will go into his dwelling-place, / and fall low on our knees before his footstool.
verses.8: Arise, O LORD, into thy resting-place, / thou, and the ark of thy strength.
verses.9: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; / and let thy saints sing with joyfulness.
verses.10: For thy servant David’s sake, / turn not away the face of thine anointed.
verses.11: The LORD hath made a faithful oath unto David, / and he shall not shrink from it:
verses.12: ‘Of the fruit of thy body / shall I set upon thy throne.
verses.13: If thy children will keep my covenant, and my testimonies that I shall teach them, / their children shall sit upon thy throne for evermore.’
verses.14: For the LORD hath chosen Sion; / he hath longed for her to be an habitation for himself:
verses.15: ‘This shall be my rest for ever: / here will I dwell, for I have a delight therein.
verses.16: I will bless her victuals with increase, / and will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.17: I will clothe her priests with salvation, / and her saints shall rejoice and sing.
verses.18: There shall I make the horn of David to flourish: / I have ordained a lantern for mine anointed.
verses.19: As for his enemies, I shall clothe them with shame; / but upon himself shall his crown flourish.’

verses.1: Behold, how good and joyful a thing it is / for brethren to dwell together in unity!
verses.2: It is like the precious oil upon the head, that ran down unto the beard, / even unto Aaron’s beard, and went down to the collar of his clothing;
verses.3: Like as the dew of Hermon, / which falleth upon the hills of Sion.
verses.4: For there the LORD promised his blessing, / even life for evermore.

verses.1: Behold now, praise the LORD, / all ye servants of the LORD;
verses.2: Ye that by night stand in the house of the LORD, / even in the courts of the house of our God.
verses.3: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, / and praise the LORD.
verses.4: The LORD that made heaven and earth / give thee blessing out of Sion.

verses.1: O Praise the LORD, laud ye the Name of the LORD; / praise it, O ye servants of the LORD,
verses.2: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, / in the courts of the house of our God.
verses.3: O praise the LORD, for the LORD is gracious: / O sing praises unto his Name, for it is lovely.
verses.4: For why? the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, / and Israel for his own possession.
verses.5: For I know that the LORD is great, / and that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.6: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven and in earth, / and in the sea, and in all deep places.
verses.7: He bringeth forth the clouds from the ends of the world, / and sendeth forth lightnings for the rain, bringing the winds out of his treasuries.
verses.8: He smote the first-born of Egypt, / both of man and beast.
verses.9: He sent signs and wonders into the midst of thee, O thou land of Egypt, / upon Pharaoh and all his servants.
verses.10: He smote many nations, / and slew mighty kings;
verses.11: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og the king of Bashan, / and all the kingdoms of Canaan;
verses.12: And gave their land to be an heritage, / even an heritage unto Israel his people.
verses.13: Thy Name, O LORD, endureth for ever: / so doth thy memorial, O LORD, from one generation to another.
verses.14: For the LORD will avenge his people, / and be gracious unto his servants.
verses.15: As for the idols of the heathen, they are but silver and gold, / the work of men’s hands.
verses.16: They have mouths, and speak not: / eyes have they, but they see not.
verses.17: They have ears, and yet they hear not: / neither is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.18: They that make them are like unto them, / and so are all they that put their trust in them.
verses.19: Praise the LORD, ye house of Israel: / praise the LORD, ye house of Aaron.
verses.20: Praise the LORD, ye house of Levi: / ye that fear the LORD, praise the LORD.
verses.21: Praised be the LORD out of Sion, / who dwelleth at Jerusalem.

verses.1: O Give thanks unto the LORD, for he is gracious: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.2: O give thanks unto the God of all gods: / for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.3: O thank the Lord of all lords: / for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.4: Who only doeth great wonders: / for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.5: Who by his excellent wisdom made the heavens: / for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.6: Who laid out the earth above the waters: / for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.7: Who hath made great lights: / for his mercy endureth for ever;
verses.8: The sun to rule the day: / for his mercy endureth for ever;
verses.9: The moon and the stars to govern the night: / for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.10: Who smote Egypt in their first-born: / for his mercy endureth for ever;
verses.11: And brought out Israel from among them: / for his mercy endureth for ever;
verses.12: With a mighty hand and stretched out arm: / for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.13: Who divided the Red Sea in sunder: / for his mercy endureth for ever;
verses.14: And made Israel to go through the midst of it: / for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.15: But as for Pharaoh and his host, he overthrew them in the Red Sea: / for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.16: Who led his people through the wilderness: / for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.17: Who smote great kings: / for his mercy endureth for ever;
verses.18: Yea, and slew mighty kings: for his mercy endureth for ever;
verses.19: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever;
verses.20: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever;
verses.21: And gave away their land for an heritage: / for his mercy endureth for ever;
