verses.22: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: / for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.23: Who remembered us when we were in trouble: / for his mercy endureth for ever;
verses.24: And hath delivered us from our enemies: / for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.25: Who giveth food to all flesh: / for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.26: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: / for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.1: By the waters of Babylon we sat down and wept, / when we remembered thee, O Sion.
verses.2: As for our harps, we hanged them up / upon the trees that are therein.
verses.3: For there they that led us away captive required of us a song, and they that plundered us a melody: / ‘Sing us one of the songs of Sion.’
verses.4: How shall we sing the LORD’ S song / in a strange land?
verses.5: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, / let my right hand forget her cunning.
verses.6: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; / yea, if I prefer not Jerusalem in my mirth.

verses.1: I Will give thanks unto thee, O LORD, with my whole heart: / even before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.
verses.2: I will worship toward thy holy temple and praise thy Name, because of thy loving-kindness and truth; / for thou hast magnified thy Name and thy word above all things.
verses.3: When I called upon thee, thou heardest me, / and enduedst my soul with much strength.
verses.4: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD;/ for they have heard the words of thy mouth.
verses.5: Yea, they shall sing of the ways of the LORD; / for great is the glory of the LORD.
verses.6: For though the LORD be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: / as for the proud, he beholdeth them afar off.
verses.7: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, yet shalt thou refresh me: / thou shalt stretch forth thy hand upon the fury of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
verses.8: The LORD shall fulfil his purpose toward me: / Yea, thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever; forsake not then the works of thine own hands.

verses.1: O Lord, thou hast searched me out and known me: / thou knowest my down-sitting and mine up-rising; thou understandest my thoughts from afar.
verses.2: Thou art about my path and about my bed, / and art acquainted with all my ways.
verses.3: For lo, there is not a word in my tongue, / but thou, O LORD, knowest it altogether.
verses.4: Thou hast beset me behind and before, / and laid thine hand upon me.
verses.5: Such knowledge is too wonderful and excellent for me: / I cannot attain unto it.
verses.6: Whither shall I go then from thy spirit? / or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
verses.7: If I climb up into heaven, thou art there: / if I go down to hell, thou art there also.
verses.8: If I take the wings of the morning, / and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea,
verses.9: Even there also shall thy hand lead me, / and thy right hand shall hold me.
verses.10: If I say, ‘Surely the darkness shall cover me, / and the light about me become night’,
verses.11: Yet even the darkness is no darkness with thee, but the night is as clear as the day: / the darkness and light to thee are both alike.
verses.12: For thou didst form my inward parts: / thou didst knit me together in my mother’s womb.
verses.13: I will give thanks unto thee, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: / marvellous are thy works, and that my soul knoweth right well.
verses.14: My frame was not hid from thee, / when I was made secretly, and fashioned beneath in the earth.
verses.15: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being imperfect; / and in thy book were all of them written,
verses.16: Even the days that were planned for me, / when as yet there was none of them.
verses.17: How dear are thy counsels unto me, O God! / O how great is the sum of them!
verses.18: If I count them, they are more in number than the sand: / when I wake up, I am present with thee.
verses.19: Wilt thou not slay the wicked, O God? / depart from me, ye bloodthirsty men.
verses.20: For they speak unrighteously against thee; / and thine enemies take thy Name in vain.
verses.21: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? / and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
verses.22: Yea, I hate them right sore; / even as though they were mine enemies.
verses.23: Try me, O God, and seek the ground of my heart: / prove me and examine my thoughts.
verses.24: Look well if there be any way of wickedness in me; / and lead me in the way everlasting.

verses.1: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: / and preserve me from the wicked man;
verses.2: Who imagine mischief in their hearts, / and stir up strife every day.
verses.3: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent: / adder’s poison is under their lips.
verses.4: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the ungodly: / preserve me from the wicked men, who are purposed to overthrow my goings.
verses.5: The proud have laid a snare for me, and spread a net abroad with cords; / yea, and set traps in my way.
verses.6: I Said unto the LORD, ‘Thou art my God’; / hear the voice of my prayers, O LORD.
verses.7: O Lord God, thou strength of my health, / thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
verses.8: Let not the ungodly have his desire, O LORD: / let not his mischievous imagination prosper.
verses.9: A Slanderer shall not prosper upon the earth: / evil shall hunt the wicked person to overthrow him.
verses.10: Sure I am that the LORD will avenge the poor, / and maintain the cause of the helpless.
verses.11: The righteous also shall give thanks unto thy Name: / and the just shall continue in thy sight.

verses.1: Lord I call upon thee; haste thee unto me, / and consider my voice when I cry unto thee.
verses.2: Let my prayer be set forth in thy sight as the incense, / and the lifting up of my hands as an evening sacrifice.
verses.3: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth, / and keep the door of my lips.
verses.4: O let not mine heart be inclined to any evil thing: / let me not be occupied in ungodly works with the men that work wickedness, neither let me eat of such things as please them.
verses.5: Let the righteous smite me in kindness, / and let him reprove me; it shall be as oil for the head;
verses.6: Let not my head refuse it; / but still my prayer shall be against their evil doings.
verses.7: But mine eyes look unto thee, O LORD God: / in thee is my trust; O cast not out my soul.
verses.8: Keep me from the snare that they have laid for me, / and from the traps of the evil doers.
verses.9: Let the ungodly fall into their own nets together, / and let me ever escape them.

verses.1: I Cry unto the LORD with my voice: / yea even unto the LORD do I make my supplication.
verses.2: I pour out my complaint before him, / and show him of my trouble.
verses.3: When my spirit was in heaviness thou knewest my path: / in the way wherein I walk have they privily laid a snare for me.
verses.4: I looked also upon my right hand, / and saw that there was no man that would know me.
verses.5: I had no place to flee unto, / and no man cared for my soul.
verses.6: I Cried unto thee, O LORD; / I said, ‘Thou art my refuge, and my portion in the land of the living.’
verses.7: Consider my complaint; / for I am brought very low.
verses.8: O deliver me from my persecutors; / for they are too strong for me.
verses.9: Bring my soul out of prison, / that I may give thanks unto thy Name.
verses.10: Then shall the righteous resort unto my company; / for thou dealest bountifully with me.

verses.1: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and consider my desire: / hearken unto me for thy truth and righteousness’ sake.
verses.2: And enter not into judgement with thy servant; / for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.
verses.3: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground: / he hath laid me in the darkness, as the men that have been long dead.
verses.4: Therefore is my spirit vexed within me, / and my heart within me is desolate.
verses.5: Yet do I remember the time past; I muse upon all thy works: / yea, I meditate upon the works of thy hands.
verses.6: I spread forth my hands unto thee: / my soul gaspeth unto thee as a thirsty land.
verses.7: Hear me, O LORD, and that soon, for my spirit waxeth faint: / hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
verses.8: O let me hear thy loving-kindness in the morning, for in thee is my trust: / show thou me the way that I should walk in, for I lift up my soul unto thee.
verses.9: Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies; / for I flee unto thee to hide me.
verses.10: Teach me to do the thing that pleaseth thee, for thou art my God: / let thy loving spirit lead me forth into the land of righteousness.
verses.11: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy Name’s sake; / and in thy righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.12: And of thy goodness cut off mine enemies, / and destroy all them that vex my soul; for I am thy servant.

verses.1: Blessed be the LORD my strength, / who teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight;
verses.2: My rock and my fortress, my castle and deliverer, my defender in whom I trust, / who subdueth the peoples under me.
verses.3: LORD, what is man, that thou hast such respect unto him, / or the son of man, that thou so regardest him?
verses.4: Man is like a thing of nought: / his time passeth away like a shadow.
verses.5: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down; / touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
verses.6: Flash forth thy lightning and scatter them: / shoot out thine arrows and consume them.
verses.7: Stretch forth thine hand from above: / deliver me, and take me out of the great waters, from the hand of strangers;
verses.8: Whose mouth talketh of vanity, / and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.9: I Will sing a new song unto thee, O God, / and sing praises unto thee upon a ten-stringed lute.
verses.10: Thou hast given victory unto kings, / and hast delivered David thy servant from the peril of the sword.
verses.11: Save me, and deliver me from the hand of strangers, / whose mouth talketh of vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.12: O That our sons may grow up as the young plants, / and that our daughters may be as the polished corners of a temple;
verses.13: That our garners may be full and plenteous with all manner of store; / that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our fields;
verses.14: That our oxen may be well laden; that there may be no breach in our walls, / no leading into captivity, and no cry of distress in our streets!
verses.15: Happy are the people that are in such a case: / yea, blessed are the people who have the LORD for their God.

verses.1: I Will magnify thee, my God and King: / and I will praise thy Name for ever and ever.
verses.2: Every day will I give thanks unto thee, / and praise thy Name for ever and ever.
verses.3: Great is the LORD, and highly to be praised; / there is no end of his greatness.
verses.4: One generation shall praise thy works unto another, / and declare thy mighty deeds.
verses.5: As for me, I will be talking of thy worship, / thy glory, thy praise, and wondrous works.
verses.6: And men shall speak of the might of thy marvellous acts; / and I will also tell of thy greatness.
verses.7: The memorial of thy abundant kindness shall be showed; / and men shall sing of thy righteousness.
verses.8: The LORD is gracious and merciful, / longsuffering, and of great kindness.
verses.9: The LORD is loving unto all: / and his mercies are over all his works.
verses.10: All thy works praise thee, O LORD, / and thy saints give thanks unto thee.
verses.11: They show the glory of thy kingdom, / and talk of thy power;
verses.12: That thy power, thy glory, and the mightiness of thy kingdom / might be known unto men.
verses.13: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, / and thy dominion endureth throughout all ages.
verses.14: The LORD is faithful in all his words, / and gracious in all his deeds.
verses.15: The LORD upholdeth all such as fall, / and lifteth up all those that are down.
verses.16: The eyes of all wait upon thee, / and thou givest them their meat in due season.
verses.17: Thou openest thy hand, / and fillest all things living with plenteousness.
verses.18: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, / and gracious in all his works.
verses.19: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, / yea, all such as call upon him faithfully.
verses.20: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: / and he will hear their cry, and will help them.
verses.21: The LORD preserveth all them that love him; / but scattereth abroad all the ungodly.
verses.22: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: / and let all flesh give thanks unto his holy Name for ever and ever.

verses.1: Praise the LORD, O my soul; while I live will I praise the LORD: / yea, as long as I have any being, I will sing praises unto my God.
verses.2: O Put not your trust in princes nor in any child of man; / for there is no help in them.
verses.3: For when the breath of man goeth forth, he shall turn again to his earth: / and then all his thoughts perish.
verses.4: Blessed is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, / and whose hope is in the LORD his God;
verses.5: Who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that therein is; / who keepeth his promise for ever;
verses.6: Who helpeth them to right that suffer wrong;/ who feedeth the hungry.
verses.7: The LORD looseth men out of prison: / the LORD giveth sight to the blind.
verses.8: The LORD raiseth up them that are fallen: / the LORD loveth the righteous.
verses.9: The LORD careth for the strangers; he upholdeth the fatherless and widow: / as for the way of the ungodly, he turneth it upside down.
verses.10: The LORD thy God, O Sion, shall be King for evermore, / and throughout all generations.

verses.1: O Praise the LORD, for it is a good thing to sing praises unto our God: / yea, a joyful and pleasant thing it is to be thankful.
verses.2: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem, / and gather together the outcasts of Israel.
verses.3: He healeth those that are broken in heart, / and bindeth up their wounds.
verses.4: He telleth the number of the stars, / and calleth them all by their names.
verses.5: Great is our Lord, and great is his power: / yea, and his wisdom is infinite.
verses.6: The LORD setteth up the meek, / and bringeth the ungodly down to the ground.
verses.7: O Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving: / sing praises upon the harp unto our God;
verses.8: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, and prepareth rain for the earth, / and maketh grass to grow upon the mountains, and herb for the use of men;
verses.9: Who giveth fodder unto the cattle, / and feedeth the young ravens that call upon him.
verses.10: He hath no pleasure in the strength of an horse, / neither delighteth he in any man’s legs.
verses.11: But the LORD’ S delight is in them that fear him, / and put their trust in his mercy.
verses.12: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem: / praise thy God, O Sion.
verses.13: For he hath made fast the bars of thy gates, / and hath blessed thy children within thee.
verses.14: He maketh peace in thy borders, / and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
verses.15: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth; / and his word runneth very swiftly.
verses.16: He giveth snow like wool, / and scattereth the hoar-frost like ashes.
verses.17: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: / who is able to abide his frost?
verses.18: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: / he bloweth with his wind, and the waters flow.
verses.19: He showeth his word unto Jacob, / his statutes and ordinances unto Israel.
verses.20: He hath not dealt so with any nation; / neither have they knowledge of his laws.

verses.1: O Praise the LORD from the heavens: / praise him in the heights.
verses.2: Praise him, all ye angels of his: / praise him, all his host.
verses.3: Praise him, sun and moon: / praise him, all ye stars of light.
verses.4: Praise him, all ye heavens, / and ye waters that are above the heavens.
verses.5: Let them praise the Name of the LORD; / for he commanded and they were created.
verses.6: He hath made them fast for ever and ever: / he hath given them a law which shall not be broken.
verses.7: Praise the LORD from the earth, / ye dragons and all deeps;
verses.8: Fire and hail, snow and vapour, / wind and storm, fulfilling his word;
verses.9: Mountains and all hills; / fruitful trees and all cedars;
verses.10: Beasts and all cattle; / creeping things and feathered fowls;
verses.11: Kings of the earth, and all peoples; / princes and all judges of the world;
verses.12: Young men and maidens together; / old men and children;
verses.13: Let them praise the Name of the LORD; / for his Name only is excellent, and his glory above heaven and earth.
verses.14: He shall exalt the horn of his people; all his saints shall praise him: / even the children of Israel, even the people that serveth him.

verses.1: O Sing unto the LORD a new song: / let the congregation of saints praise him.
verses.2: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: / and let the children of Sion be joyful in their King.
verses.3: Let them praise his Name in the dance: / let them sing praises unto him with timbrel and harp.
verses.4: For the LORD hath pleasure in his people, / and adorneth the humble with salvation.
verses.5: Let the saints be joyful with glory: / let them sing for joy upon their couches.
verses.6: Let the praises of God be in their mouth, / and a two-edged sword in their hands;
verses.7: To be avenged of the nations, / and to rebuke the peoples;
verses.8: To bind their kings in chains, / and their nobles with links of iron;
verses.9: To execute upon them the judgement that is written. / Such honour have all his saints.

verses.1: O Praise God in his sanctuary: / praise him in the firmament of his power.
verses.2: Praise him in his mighty acts: / praise him according to his excellent greatness.
verses.3: Praise him in the sound of the trumpet: / praise him upon the lute and harp.
verses.4: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: / praise him upon the strings and pipe.
verses.5: Praise him upon the well-tuned cymbals: / praise him upon the loud cymbals.
verses.6: Let every thing that hath breath / praise the LORD.
